You Get Exactly What You Design

Every jersey is built to your specifications — your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers. We don't substitute materials or simplify your design to save production time. What you approve in the proof is what your team wears on the court.

Free Design Service

No design skills needed. Send us your logo, colors, and ideas — our team handles the artwork at no extra charge. You approve before anything goes to production.

No Hidden Costs

The price you're quoted is the price you pay. Design is free. Shipping is free. No setup fees, no artwork charges, no surprise line items when your invoice arrives.

Fast Production Turnaround

We understand season deadlines. Our production timeline is built around getting your team game-ready — not making you wait weeks longer than necessary.

Any Order Size Welcome

Whether you need 5 jerseys for a small travel team or 200 for a full school program, we handle both with the same attention to quality and detail.

Florida Teams Are Our Focus

We specifically serve Florida schools, clubs, travel teams, and leagues. We understand your season schedules, climate, and what local programs need from their uniforms.

Youth & Adult Sizing

Proof Approval Before Production

Not Sure Which

Every team has different needs. Game jerseys, practice jerseys, reversible uniforms, youth sizes, bulk orders — it can be a lot to sort through. Use this guide to find the right fit for your specific situation, then request a free quote with confidence.

Game Day Uniforms

You need official jerseys for competitive games

You want something that looks sharp, represents your team's brand, and holds up through a full season of play. Sublimated jerseys are the strongest choice here — full-color, edge-to-edge design that won't crack or peel.

Best fit Sublimated Jerseys
Home & Away

You need both a home and away jersey without double the cost

Reversible jerseys are built for exactly this. Two different designs — one on each side. Your players flip the jersey depending on which team is wearing which color. Perfect for travel teams and leagues.

Best fit Reversible Jerseys
Youth Programs

You're outfitting kids — ages 6 through 18

Youth sizes run from XS to XL and can be mixed with adult sizes in a single order. Lightweight and mesh fabrics work best for younger players — breathable, easy to move in, and durable enough for weekly games.

Best fit Youth Uniforms
Practice & Training

You need jerseys for daily practice — not just game day

Practice jerseys take more punishment than game jerseys. You want something durable, comfortable, and easy to wash. Mesh practice jerseys are the go-to — affordable enough to outfit the whole squad including alternates.

Best fit Practice Jerseys
Full Uniform Set

You want a complete matched uniform — jersey and shorts together

A matching jersey and shorts set creates a professional, cohesive look on the court. We custom-produce the shorts to match your jersey colors and design exactly — ordered as a set from a single quote.

Best fit Full Uniform Sets
Women's Programs

Everything Florida coaches, athletic directors, and program managers ask before placing their first order. Can't find your answer here? Request a free quote and ask us directly — we respond within 24 hours.

Start by requesting a free quote on our website. Tell us your jersey style, quantity, team colors, player names, numbers, and any logo or design ideas. We'll review your request, create a full digital proof, and send it to you for approval — all at no charge. Nothing goes to production until you're happy with the design.

Yes — completely free. Our design team creates your full jersey artwork at no charge, including your logo, team name, player names, numbers, and color scheme. There are no setup fees, no artwork charges, and no per-revision costs. You can request changes until you're fully satisfied, and you only pay once the design is approved and the order is confirmed.

There is no strict minimum order quantity. We welcome orders of any size — from a single replacement jersey to a full program order of 200 or more. Small travel teams and individual orders are just as welcome as bulk school orders. Pricing is provided upfront in your free quote so you know exactly what to expect before committing.

We carry a full size range from Youth XS through Adult 5XL, covering men's, women's, and youth cuts. You can mix sizes within a single order — ideal for programs ordering for full rosters with a combination of youth and adult players. Just include each player's size in your quote request and we'll handle everything from there.

Production and delivery timelines depend on your order size, design complexity, and shipping destination. We'll confirm an estimated delivery date in your quote before you commit. If you have a specific first game date or season deadline, mention it in your quote request and we'll let you know whether we can meet it — always before any payment is made.

Yes. Our reversible basketball jerseys feature two fully custom designs — one on each side. They're ideal for travel teams, leagues where home and away colors change each game, and programs looking to reduce the cost of ordering two separate jersey sets. Both sides are fully customizable with names, numbers, logos, and colors.

Yes — every jersey in your order can have a unique player name and number at no extra cost. Simply include a roster list with each player's name, number, and size when you submit your quote request. There are no per-name or per-number fees. The full customization is included in the base price of your order.

Yes — shipping is free on every order delivered to any address across all 50 US states. There is no minimum order value required to qualify for free shipping and no hidden delivery charge added at checkout. The price quoted is the price you pay, with shipping fully included.

We primarily use dye sublimation printing — a process where color is infused directly into the fabric rather than printed on top of it. This means colors are vivid, edge-to-edge, and permanent — they won't crack, peel, or fade after washing. Sublimation is the same method used in professional-level athletic apparel and is ideal for full-color custom jersey designs.

No — you don't need any design files to get started. If you have a logo, send it over and we'll incorporate it. If you don't have a logo, our design team will create one for you based on your team name, colors, and preferences. We can work from a rough sketch, a reference image, or just a written description. You'll see the full design in your proof before anything is produced.

Yes. We produce custom basketball shorts matched to your jersey design — same colors, same logo placement, same overall aesthetic. Ordering a complete uniform set (jersey and shorts together) from a single quote request is the most straightforward way to ensure a perfectly coordinated look for your team on game day.

For Florida programs playing in hot, humid gyms and outdoor courts, we recommend our mesh and moisture-wicking lightweight fabrics. These materials maximize airflow, pull sweat away from the skin, and keep players cool during intense play. We'll recommend the most suitable fabric option for your use case as part of the quote process — just mention your playing environment when you reach out.

Yes — you can mix youth and adult sizes within a single order with no issue. This is common for school programs and youth leagues that have a mix of younger players and adult coaching staff needing matching gear. Just include each person's name, number, and size in your roster list and we'll produce every jersey in the correct size from a single production run, ensuring consistent colors throughout.

We keep your team's design on file after your first order. If a new player joins mid-season and needs a jersey to match the rest of the team, simply contact us with the new player's name, number, and size. We'll reproduce from the same saved design file, so the new jersey will match the existing set perfectly — same colors, same layout, same quality.

Yes — we supply custom basketball jerseys and uniforms to schools, clubs, leagues, and programs across every city and county in Florida, including Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Gainesville, Tallahassee, Fort Lauderdale, Pensacola, Sarasota, and beyond. Free shipping applies to all Florida addresses and across all 50 US states. Our Story

Built for
Florida
Basketball

We're a Florida-focused custom jersey supplier built around one mission: making it simple for coaches, athletic directors, and program managers to get professional custom uniforms — without hidden fees, template restrictions, or the runaround.

Get a Free Quote Browse Our Jerseys
Florida Basketball Jerseys — At a Glance
Based in
Orlando, FLServing all of Florida
Speciality
Custom JerseysBasketball uniforms & sets
Design service
Always FreeNo artwork fees ever
Shipping
Always FreeAll 50 US states
Order minimum
None1 jersey or 500 — both welcome
Sizes available
Youth XS – 5XLMen's, women's & youth
Quote response
Within 24 hrsDesign proof included
Who We Are

Florida's Dedicated
Basketball Jersey Supplier

Florida Basketball Jerseys exists because we saw a gap in the market — Florida's booming basketball community deserved a custom jersey supplier that understood the sport, understood the state, and understood what coaches and program managers actually need when ordering uniforms.

Too many teams were stuck dealing with national suppliers that treated every order the same: rigid templates, surprise fees, limited customization, and no real understanding of season deadlines or local basketball culture.

We built something different. A supplier that starts from scratch on every jersey, charges nothing for design, ships free across the USA, and takes the time to understand your program before a single jersey goes to production.

From youth rec leagues in Tampa to competitive travel programs in Miami, high school programs in Jacksonville to community leagues across Central Florida — we outfit them all with the same level of care and quality.

Honesty First

The price you're quoted is the price you pay. No hidden fees, no setup charges, no artwork surprises. We say what we charge and we charge what we say.

Quality That Lasts

We use dye sublimation printing on performance fabrics — colors that don't crack or fade, stitching that holds through a full season of wear.

Deadline Aware

We know basketball seasons don't wait. Every order is tracked against your game-ready date — we'll tell you if we can hit your deadline before you commit.

Florida Focused

We're not a generic national supplier. Florida basketball is all we do — which means faster response, better fabric recommendations, and service built around FL season structures.

Our Journey

How We Got Here

From a simple idea to Florida's dedicated basketball jersey supplier — here's the story behind what we built.

2018
The Problem We Saw

A Florida youth basketball coach reached out to a dozen custom jersey suppliers for a simple 14-jersey order. Every one charged extra for design, added shipping on top, and three couldn't even do youth sizes. That frustration planted a seed.

2019
Florida Basketball Jerseys Is Born

We launched with a clear position: free design, free shipping, no minimums, and a focus exclusively on Florida basketball. Our first orders came from travel teams and rec leagues across the Orlando area.

2020
Expanding Across Florida

Word spread quickly across the Florida basketball community. Programs in Tampa, Miami, Jacksonville, and Gainesville began ordering with us. We expanded our size range to Youth XS through Adult 5XL to serve every type of program in a single order.

2022
Schools & Programs Come On Board

We began receiving bulk orders from Florida middle schools, high school athletic departments, and AAU programs. Our design-saved re-order system was built specifically for programs that need to add players mid-season without redesigning from scratch.

Today
Florida's Go-To Jersey Supplier

We now serve teams, schools, leagues, travel programs, and rec centers across all 67 Florida counties. Free design, free shipping, and zero minimums remain the foundation of everything we do — and always will.

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

01
No Hidden Costs. Ever.

Design is free. Shipping is free. Player names and numbers are included. The quote you receive is the total you pay — no setup fees, no artwork charges, no delivery surprises.

02
Proof Before Payment

We send a full digital mockup of your jerseys before you commit to anything. Front, back, your colors, your logo. You approve it — then and only then do we take payment.

03
100% Custom — No Templates

Every jersey we produce starts from a blank canvas. Your colors, your logo, your design — not a pre-made template with limited color swaps. True full customization on every order.

04
Any Order Size Welcome

A single jersey for a new player. A full program order of 200. We handle both with the same turnaround, the same attention to detail, and the same price transparency.

05
Design Saved for Re-Orders

After your first order, we store your design on file. Adding a new player mid-season takes minutes — we reproduce from the same saved file so colors and layout match perfectly.

06
Florida Only — No Generic Service

We don't try to serve every sport in every state. Florida basketball is our entire focus — which means we respond faster, know your season schedule, and understand what programs here actually need.

Our Commitment to Florida

Every City.
Every Program.
Every Season.

Florida has one of the most active year-round basketball communities in the country. From the Panhandle to the Keys, from youth rec leagues to competitive AAU travel programs, every Florida basketball team deserves access to professional custom jerseys at a fair price — without the runaround.

We ship to every city and county across the state. Free shipping applies to every order — no minimum spend, no location surcharge.

Miami Orlando Tampa Jacksonville Fort Lauderdale Gainesville Tallahassee St. Petersburg Pensacola Sarasota Daytona Beach Boca Raton + All 67 Counties
Year-Round Season Support

Florida basketball runs year-round — fall leagues, winter seasons, spring tournaments, summer travel. We're available to take orders every month, not just during peak season.

Fabrics Suited to Florida Heat

Florida gyms and courts run hot. We recommend breathable mesh and moisture-wicking fabrics that perform in high heat and humidity — made for Florida, not just available here.

School & Program Familiarity

We understand how Florida school districts, AAU programs, and rec leagues operate — their budget timelines, approval processes, and the reality of coaching-staff-sized orders.

Dedicated to Getting It Right

Every jersey is inspected before it ships. Colors are verified against your approved proof. Names and numbers are checked against your roster. We ship when it's right — not before.

The People Behind the Jerseys

Meet Our Team

Every quote request is handled by a real person — not a bot, not an overseas call center. Here's who you'll be working with.

MR
Marcus R.
Founder & Director

Former Florida youth basketball coach. Built this business from scratch after one too many bad jersey experiences on behalf of his teams.

JL
Jamie L.
Lead Designer

Sports apparel designer with 8+ years of experience. Creates every design proof that goes to customers — no templates, always custom.

TC
Tara C.
Customer Success

Handles every quote request and order communication. Florida native, former athletic department administrator, speaks your language.

DM
Devon M.
Production & QC

Oversees production quality and pre-shipment checks. Every jersey that leaves our facility has been inspected against your approved proof.

Work With Us

Let's Build Your
Team's Jerseys

Request a free quote today. Free design, free USA shipping, no minimums, no payment until you approve your proof. We respond within 24 hours.

Request a Free Quote Contact Our Team

No commitment required — get your design proof and pricing within 24 hours

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .fbj-con-wrap {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  /* ==============================
     HERO
  ============================== */
  .fbj-con-hero {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 72px 24px 80px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-con-hero-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-con-hero-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .fbj-con-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .fbj-con-eyebrow-dot {

			#payment .payment_methods > li .payment_box,

<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .fbj-cp-wrap {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  /* ==============================
     HERO
  ============================== */
  .fbj-cp-hero {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 64px 24px 72px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .fbj-cp-breadcrumb {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-cp-breadcrumb a {
    color: #4A6A84;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-cp-breadcrumb a:hover { color: #FF8C2A; }
  .fbj-cp-breadcrumb-sep { color: #2E4A60; }
  .fbj-cp-breadcrumb-current { color: #A3B5CC; font-weight: 500; }

  .fbj-cp-hero-tag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.25);
    border-radius: 100px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-h1 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 0.95;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-h1 span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-cp-hero-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: #4A6A84;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-meta-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-hero-meta-item svg { color: #F4700A; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ==============================
     COOKIE TYPES STRIP
  ============================== */
  .fbj-cp-types-strip {
    background: #112444;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    padding: 0 24px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-types-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-item {
    flex: 1 1 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 20px 16px;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .fbj-cp-type-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }

  .fbj-cp-type-dot {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #E8EFF8;
    line-height: 1.3;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-req {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-req--required {
    background: rgba(192,32,42,0.12);
    color: #E06070;
    border: 1px solid rgba(192,32,42,0.2);
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-req--optional {
    background: rgba(232,196,0,0.1);
    color: #B89800;
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,196,0,0.2);
  }

  .fbj-cp-type-req--consent {
    background: rgba(30,125,58,0.1);
    color: #3A9A6A;
    border: 1px solid rgba(30,125,58,0.2);
  }

  /* ==============================
     MAIN LAYOUT
  ============================== */
  .fbj-cp-main {
    padding: 64px 24px 80px;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  .fbj-cp-main-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 260px;
    gap: 52px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  /* ==============================
     DOCUMENT
  ============================== */
  .fbj-cp-doc {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(11,31,58,0.05);
  }

  .fbj-cp-doc-head {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 28px 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-cp-doc-head-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  .fbj-cp-doc-head-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    line-height: 1.5;
    text-align: right;
  }

  .fbj-cp-doc-body { padding: 44px 40px; }

  /* Intro box */
  .fbj-cp-intro-box {
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.18);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-intro-box p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-cp-intro-box p strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* What is a cookie explainer */
  .fbj-cp-explainer {
    background: #F5F7FA;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .fbj-cp-explainer-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.18);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #F4700A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-explainer-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0B1F3A;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .fbj-cp-explainer-body {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-cp-explainer-body strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Section */
  .fbj-cp-section {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
  }

  .fbj-cp-section:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-section-num {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-section-num-badge {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: #F4700A;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-section-num-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
  }

  .fbj-cp-section-h2 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0B1F3A;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .fbj-cp-prose {
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.85;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-cp-prose p { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .fbj-cp-prose p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fbj-cp-prose strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  .fbj-cp-prose a {
    color: #F4700A;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-cp-prose a:hover {
    color: #D95F05;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  /* List */
  .fbj-cp-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 12px 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-cp-list li::before {
    content: '';
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #F4700A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 7px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-list li strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Cookie type cards */
  .fbj-cp-cookie-cards {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    margin: 16px 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card {
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 22px 20px;
    border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card--essential {
    background: rgba(192,32,42,0.04);
    border-color: rgba(192,32,42,0.15);
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card--analytics {
    background: rgba(232,196,0,0.04);
    border-color: rgba(232,196,0,0.2);
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card--preference {
    background: rgba(26,94,190,0.04);
    border-color: rgba(26,94,190,0.15);
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card--marketing {
    background: rgba(107,47,174,0.04);
    border-color: rgba(107,47,174,0.15);
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-dot {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title--essential { color: #C0202A; }
  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title--analytics { color: #8A7200; }
  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title--preference { color: #1A5EBE; }
  .fbj-cp-cookie-card-title--marketing { color: #6B2FAE; }

  .fbj-cp-cookie-status {
    font-size: 11px;

Home › FAQ
Common Questions

Frequently Asked
Questions

Everything Florida coaches, athletic directors, and program managers ask before placing their first custom jersey order. Can't find your answer? Ask us directly.

No Questions Found

Try a different search term or browse all categories. If you can't find your answer, contact us directly.

Ask Us Directly
Ordering Process 7 Questions

Start by requesting a free quote. Tell us your jersey style, quantity, team colors, player names, numbers, and any logo or design ideas. We'll review your request, create a full digital proof at no charge, and send it for your approval. Nothing goes to production until you're happy with the design and payment has been received.

There is no minimum order quantity. We welcome orders of any size — from a single replacement jersey for a new player to a full program order of 200 or more. Small travel teams and individual orders are just as welcome as large bulk school orders. Pricing is confirmed in your free quote before you commit.

You can cancel or modify your order at any time before you approve the design proof and make payment. Once payment has been received and production has started, orders cannot be cancelled or changed because your jerseys are being custom-made specifically for your team. See our Refund Policy for full details.

Total lead time from approved proof to delivered order is typically 10–21 days depending on order size and delivery location. We send your design proof within 24–48 hours of your quote request. Production takes 7–14 business days for most orders. Shipping adds 3–7 days. Your specific timeline is confirmed in your written quote.

Yes — every jersey in your order can have a unique player name and number at no extra cost. Simply include a roster list with each player's name, number, and size when you submit your quote request. There are no per-name or per-number fees. The full customisation is included in the base price of your order.

Yes — you can mix youth and adult sizes within a single order. We carry Youth XS through Adult 5XL, covering men's, women's, and youth cuts. Just include each player's name, number, and size in your roster list and we'll produce every jersey in the correct size from a single production run.

We keep your team's design on file after your first order. When a new player joins, simply contact us with their name, number, and size. We reproduce from the same saved design file so the new jersey will match the existing set perfectly — same colors, same layout, same quality — without starting from scratch.

Design & Customisation 5 Questions

Yes — completely free. Our design team creates your full jersey artwork at no charge, including your logo, team name, player names, numbers, and color scheme. There are no setup fees, no artwork charges, and no per-revision costs. You only pay once the design is approved and the order is confirmed.

No — you don't need any design files to get started. If you have a logo, send it and we'll incorporate it. If you don't have a logo, our team will create one based on your team name, colors, and preferences. We can work from a rough sketch, a reference image, or just a written description. You'll see everything in your proof before production.

Unlimited. We revise your design proof as many times as needed until you are fully happy with it. There is no limit on revisions and no additional charge for changes. We want to make sure the proof is perfect before you approve it, because once production starts we cannot make further changes.

We primarily use dye sublimation printing — a process where color is infused directly into the fabric rather than printed on top. This produces vivid, edge-to-edge color that is permanent and will not crack, peel, or fade after washing. It is the same method used in professional-level athletic apparel.

Yes. We produce custom basketball shorts matched exactly to your jersey design — same colors, same logo placement, same overall aesthetic. Ordering a complete uniform set (jersey + shorts) from a single quote request is the best way to ensure a perfectly coordinated look on the court.

Products & Sizing 5 Questions

We carry a full size range from Youth XS through Adult 5XL, covering men's, women's, and youth cuts. You can mix sizes within a single order with no issue — ideal for programs ordering for full rosters with a combination of youth and adult players.

Yes. Our reversible basketball jerseys feature two fully custom designs — one on each side. They are ideal for travel teams, leagues where home and away colors change each game, and programs wanting both looks without ordering two separate sets. Both sides are fully customizable with names, numbers, logos, and colors.

For Florida programs playing in hot, humid conditions, we recommend our mesh and moisture-wicking lightweight fabrics. These maximize airflow, pull sweat away from the skin, and keep players cool during intense play. We'll recommend the best fabric for your use case as part of your quote — just mention your playing environment when you reach out.

Yes — we supply to schools, clubs, leagues, and programs across every city and county in Florida, including Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Gainesville, Tallahassee, Fort Lauderdale, Pensacola, Sarasota, and beyond. Free shipping applies to all Florida addresses and across all 50 US states.

Our sublimation-printed jerseys are designed to last a full season and beyond. Because the color is infused into the fabric fibres rather than printed on top, there is nothing to crack, peel, or flake. Colors remain vibrant through repeated washing. For best results, wash inside out in cold water and avoid high-heat tumble drying.

Shipping & Delivery 4 Questions

Yes — shipping is free on every order delivered to any address across all 50 US states. There is no minimum order value required to qualify and no hidden delivery charge added at checkout or invoice. The price you're quoted is the total price you pay, with shipping fully included. See our Shipping Policy for full details.

Tell us your first game date in your quote request and we'll confirm whether we can deliver on time before you commit. If we cannot meet the deadline with standard production, we'll tell you immediately so you can plan accordingly. We recommend ordering at least 4 weeks before your first game date to allow for production and shipping.

Yes. Once your order has been produced, quality-checked, and dispatched, we'll send you a dispatch confirmation email with your tracking number and a link to track your package in real time. Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to update in the carrier's system after dispatch.

Contact us within 7 days of delivery with clear photos of the issue and your order details. If we made a production error, we will reprint or refund at no cost to you. We respond to all claims within 3 business days. See our Refund Policy for the full claims process and eligibility criteria.

Pricing & Payment 4 Questions

No. The price quoted is the price you pay. Design is free. Shipping is free. Player names and numbers are included. There are no setup fees, no artwork charges, no per-name or per-number fees, and no surprise delivery charges on your invoice. We quote clearly and charge exactly what we quote.

You do not pay until you have approved your design proof. We send your proof, you request any changes, and once you're completely happy you approve it in writing. Payment is then required in full before production begins. No payment is ever taken before you see and approve your design.

Yes — pricing per jersey typically improves for larger orders. The exact pricing for your order size will be confirmed in your free quote. We handle everything from single jerseys to full program orders of 200+, and larger orders generally benefit from better per-unit pricing. Request a quote to get your specific pricing.

If your order contains a production error that differs from your approved proof, we will reprint or refund at no cost. However, because all jerseys are custom-made to order, returns are not accepted for change of mind or errors present in the approved proof. Review all proofs carefully before approving. See our full Refund Policy for details.

Request a Free Quote

Get Pricing
Start Your Jersey Quote

Optional. Max file size limit will depend on your server settings.

					<!-- ============================================================
  HOW IT WORKS PAGE
  Florida Basketball Jerseys — floridabasketballjerseys.com
  Paste into Elementor HTML widget on /how-it-works page.
  All colors hardcoded.
============================================================ -->

<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .fbj-hiw-wrap {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  /* ==============================
     HERO
  ============================== */
  .fbj-hiw-hero {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 72px 24px 88px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-breadcrumb {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-breadcrumb a { color: #4A6A84; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; }
  .fbj-hiw-breadcrumb a:hover { color: #FF8C2A; }
  .fbj-hiw-breadcrumb-sep { color: #2E4A60; }
  .fbj-hiw-breadcrumb-current { color: #A3B5CC; font-weight: 500; }

  .fbj-hiw-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.25);
    border-radius: 100px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-h1 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 0.95;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-h1 span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-body {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: #A3B5CC;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    max-width: 480px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-body strong { color: #E8EFF8; font-weight: 600; }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-ctas {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .fbj-btn-hiw-primary {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: #F4700A;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 13px 24px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .fbj-btn-hiw-primary:hover {
    background: #D95F05;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .fbj-btn-hiw-ghost {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: #E8EFF8;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 12px 22px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .fbj-btn-hiw-ghost:hover {
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* Promise pills */
  .fbj-hiw-hero-pills {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 100px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #A3B5CC;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-pill svg { color: #F4700A; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* Right: hero step overview card */
  .fbj-hiw-hero-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-card-head {
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.2);
    padding: 16px 22px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FF8C2A;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-steps {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px 22px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .fbj-hiw-hero-step:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step-num {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.15);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step-text {}

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step-title {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #E8EFF8;
    line-height: 1.3;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-hero-step-time {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ==============================
     STEP TIMELINE SECTION
  ============================== */
  .fbj-hiw-steps-section {
    background: #F5F7FA;
    padding: 88px 24px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-steps-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-section-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 72px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-section-eyebrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-section-h2 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0B1F3A;
    line-height: 1.0;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-section-h2 span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-hiw-section-sub {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #4A6070;
    max-width: 520px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* Step cards */
  .fbj-hiw-step-cards {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* Vertical connecting line */
  .fbj-hiw-step-cards::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 52px;
    top: 56px;
    bottom: 56px;
    width: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F4700A 0%, rgba(244,112,10,0.15) 100%);
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 106px 1fr;
    gap: 0;
    align-items: start;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* Step number column */
  .fbj-hiw-step-num-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding-top: 4px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-circle {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 2.5px solid #F4700A;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(244,112,10,0.15);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-circle-num {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #F4700A;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-circle-label {
    font-size: 8.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8AACBF;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  /* Step content */
  .fbj-hiw-step-content {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-left: 24px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-content:hover {
    border-color: rgba(244,112,10,0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(244,112,10,0.08);
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-content-head {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 22px 28px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-tag {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 1.1;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-time-badge {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.3);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-time-val {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-time-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #6A8499;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-body-wrap {
    padding: 28px 28px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 28px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-desc {
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.85;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-desc strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  .fbj-hiw-step-desc a {
    color: #F4700A;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-desc a:hover { color: #D95F05; text-decoration: underline; }

  /* Step checklist */
  .fbj-hiw-step-checks {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 9px;
    background: #F5F7FA;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px 16px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-checks-title {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8AACBF;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #4A6070;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-check-icon {
    width: 17px;
    height: 17px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.25);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #F4700A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-check strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Step action button */
  .fbj-hiw-step-action {
    padding: 0 28px 24px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-action-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    background: #F4700A;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 11px 20px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.2s ease;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-step-action-btn:hover {
    background: #D95F05;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* ==============================
     WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
  ============================== */
  .fbj-hiw-need {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 88px 24px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 52px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-eyebrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-h2 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 46px);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 1.0;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-h2 span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-hiw-need-sub {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: #6A8499;
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 28px 22px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card:hover {
    border-color: rgba(244,112,10,0.4);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #E8EFF8;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-items {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 7px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #6A8499;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-item::before {
    content: '';
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #F4700A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-card-item strong { color: #A3B5CC; font-weight: 600; }

  .fbj-hiw-need-note {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 36px;
    padding: 20px 24px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.18);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #8AAAC4;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-need-note strong { color: #E8EFF8; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ==============================
     TIMELINE OVERVIEW STRIP
  ============================== */
  .fbj-hiw-timeline {
    background: #F5F7FA;
    padding: 72px 24px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-timeline-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-timeline-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-timeline-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
    position: relative;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(11,31,58,0.06);
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-tl-cell {
    padding: 28px 20px;
    text-align: center;
    border-right: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
    position: relative;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-hiw-tl-cell:last-child { border-right: none; }

						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );

						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {

						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',

Florida Basketball Jerseys — Orlando, FL
Florida Basketball Jerseys — Privacy Policy
Last updated: January 1, 2025
Effective: January 1, 2025

At Florida Basketball Jerseys, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and what rights you have over your data. By using our website at floridabasketballjerseys.com or placing an order with us, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

We Never Sell Your Data
Your personal information is never sold to third parties — ever.
Data Used Only to Serve You
We only use your information to fulfil your order and communicate with you.
You Control Your Data
You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time.
1
Section 1

Who We Are

This Privacy Policy applies to Florida Basketball Jerseys ("Company," "we," "our," or "us"), a custom basketball jersey and uniform supplier based in Orlando, Florida, operating the website floridabasketballjerseys.com.

For any privacy-related questions or requests, you can contact our team directly:

  • Email: info@floridabasketballjerseys.com
  • Phone: (407) 555-0192
  • Address: 4820 S. Orange Ave, Suite 110, Orlando, FL 32806
2
Section 2

What Information We Collect

We collect information you voluntarily provide to us, as well as certain information collected automatically when you visit our website. Here is a breakdown of the types of data we may collect:

Data Type Examples How Collected
Contact Information Name, email address, phone number Quote forms, contact forms, email
Order Information Jersey styles, quantities, sizes, team name, colors, player names & numbers Quote requests, order forms
Shipping Information Delivery address, city, state, ZIP code Order confirmation process
Payment Information Payment method details processed via third-party payment processors Order payment stage
Design Files Logos, artwork, images uploaded for custom jersey design Submitted during order process
Communication Records Emails, messages, and correspondence related to your order Email and contact form exchanges
Technical Data IP address, browser type, pages visited, time on site Automatically via cookies and server logs

We do not collect: We do not collect sensitive personal information such as government ID numbers, Social Security numbers, racial or ethnic origin, health information, or financial account login credentials. Payment card details are processed entirely by our third-party payment processor and are never stored on our servers.

3
Section 3

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • Order Fulfilment: To process your quote request, create your design proof, produce your jerseys, and arrange delivery to your address.
  • Communication: To respond to your enquiries, send design proofs, provide order updates, and follow up on delivery.
  • Customer Support: To assist you with questions, issues, or requests relating to your order.
  • Re-Orders: To store your design on file for future re-orders, allowing us to reproduce matching jerseys for new players.
  • Business Operations: To maintain our records, process payments, and manage our business legally and efficiently.
  • Website Improvement: To understand how visitors use our website and make improvements to our services.
  • Legal Compliance: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal obligations.
  • Marketing (with your consent): To send you occasional information about our services and promotions, only if you have opted in. You can unsubscribe at any time.

We do not use your data for automated decision-making, profiling, or any purpose unrelated to serving your order and maintaining our business.

4
Section 4

How We Share Your Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party. We may share your information only in the following limited circumstances:

  • Shipping Carriers: We share your name and delivery address with shipping carriers (such as UPS, FedEx, or USPS) solely to deliver your order.
  • Payment Processors: Payment information is processed by our third-party payment processor. We do not store payment card details on our servers.
  • Production Partners: In some cases, we may work with trusted production partners who assist in manufacturing your jerseys. These partners are bound by confidentiality obligations and may not use your information for any other purpose.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law, court order, or governmental authority, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Florida Basketball Jerseys, our customers, or others.
  • Business Transfer: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our business assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you in advance of any such change.

All third parties who receive your data are required to handle it securely and only for the specific purpose for which it was shared. No third party has permission to use your data for their own marketing or business purposes.

5
Section 5

Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your browsing experience and understand how visitors use our site. A cookie is a small text file stored on your device by your browser.

We use the following types of cookies:

  • Essential Cookies: Required for basic website functionality such as form submission and page navigation. These cannot be disabled without affecting the website.
  • Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website (e.g., which pages are most visited). We may use tools like Google Analytics for this purpose.
  • Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and preferences for a better experience on return visits.
  • Marketing Cookies: Used to display relevant advertisements. These are only placed with your consent.

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website. For more information about how we use cookies specifically, please see our Cookie Policy.

6
Section 6

Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including for the duration of our business relationship with you and as required by applicable law.

  • Order records and correspondence are retained for a minimum of 7 years for legal and accounting purposes.
  • Design files are stored on file to support re-orders. You may request deletion of your design files at any time by contacting us.
  • Website analytics data is retained in aggregate, anonymized form for business analysis.
  • Marketing communications subscriber data is retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion.

When your data is no longer needed, we will delete or anonymize it securely.

7
Section 7

Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. These measures include:

  • SSL encryption on our website to protect data transmitted between your browser and our server.
  • Secure email communications for sharing sensitive order information.
  • Restricted access to personal data — only authorized team members who need it to fulfil your order can access it.
  • Secure storage of order records and design files.
  • Use of trusted, reputable third-party processors for payment handling.

While we take every reasonable precaution, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your data. In the event of a data breach that is likely to affect your rights, we will notify you as required by applicable law.

8
Section 8

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information. We will respond to all verified requests within 30 days.

Right to Access
Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Right to Correction
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to Deletion
Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal obligations.
Right to Portability
Request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Right to Object
Object to certain types of processing, including marketing communications.
Opt-Out of Marketing
Unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time via the link in any email.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request. We will respond within 30 days.

Florida Residents: Florida residents may have additional rights under the Florida Digital Bill of Rights (FDBR) if it applies to our operations. We are committed to complying with all applicable Florida privacy laws.

9
Section 9

Children's Privacy

Our website and services are directed at adults, including coaches, athletic directors, parents, and program administrators. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under the age of 13.

When an order includes custom jerseys for youth players (such as a youth basketball team), the personal information submitted (player names, numbers, sizes) is provided by an adult on behalf of the team or program, not directly by the child.

If you believe we have inadvertently collected personal information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com and we will take prompt action to delete it.

10
Section 10

Third-Party Links & Services

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. These links are provided for your convenience and do not signify our endorsement of those websites. We have no control over the content, privacy practices, or security of third-party websites.

We encourage you to read the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit through links on our site. This Privacy Policy applies only to information collected by Florida Basketball Jerseys through our website and services.

11
Section 11

International Data Transfers

Florida Basketball Jerseys is based in Orlando, Florida, USA. Our website and services are directed primarily at customers in the United States. If you are accessing our website from outside the United States, please be aware that your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States.

By using our services, you consent to the transfer of your information to the United States and its processing there in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

12
Section 12

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.

We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of our website or services after any changes have been posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy. If the changes are significant, we will make reasonable efforts to notify you by email (if you have provided one) or by placing a prominent notice on our website.

13
Section 13

Contact Us About Your Privacy

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us:

  • Business Name: Florida Basketball Jerseys
  • Address: 4820 S. Orange Ave, Suite 110, Orlando, FL 32806
  • Email: info@floridabasketballjerseys.com
  • Phone: (407) 555-0192
  • Business Hours: Monday–Friday 9am–6pm EST, Saturday 10am–3pm EST

We are committed to resolving any privacy concerns promptly and transparently. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Privacy Questions?

Email us at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com or call (407) 555-0192. We respond within 24 hours.

Contact Us

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Basketball Practice Jerseys

Basketball practice jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys built specifically for the demanding requirements of daily training sessions, skill development, and intensive practice activities across Florida, where durability and performance matter more than appearance but teams still want to maintain their identity during the crucial hours spent developing basketball skills. These practice jerseys use materials and construction designed to withstand frequent washing, aggressive drills, and the general wear that comes with daily basketball training while providing moisture-wicking performance that keeps Florida players comfortable during long practice sessions. The practice-focused design prioritizes functionality and team cohesion during training, with customization options for team identification and player organization that help coaches run efficient practices while building the team chemistry that translates to game day success, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting practice squads both affordable and straightforward.

What makes practice jerseys different from game jerseys?

Practice jerseys prioritize durability and cost-effectiveness over premium appearance, using materials designed for frequent washing and intensive daily training sessions.

How do practice jerseys help with team organization during training?

Practice jerseys can include numbers, names, or color coding that help coaches organize drills, scrimmages, and training activities efficiently.

Can practice jerseys match game jersey colors and designs?

Yes, practice jerseys can coordinate with game uniforms using team colors and simplified versions of game designs to maintain team identity during training.

How durable are practice jerseys for daily Florida basketball training?

Practice jerseys are specifically designed for high-frequency use with reinforced construction, fade-resistant materials, and graphics tested for season-long durability.

What customization options work best for practice jerseys?

Simple team names, player numbers, and practice designations work well, focusing on functionality that helps coaches and players during training activities.

Can teams order practice jerseys separately from game uniforms?

Absolutely – many Florida teams order practice jerseys independently, and we can maintain design consistency between practice and game uniforms.

What’s the typical production time for practice jerseys?

Practice jerseys typically have faster 7-10 business day turnaround since they use streamlined designs focused on functionality over complex graphics.

How do practice jerseys handle Florida’s intensive training schedules?

Practice jerseys use moisture-wicking materials and construction designed for daily use in Florida’s warm climate and demanding basketball training conditions.

Are practice jerseys more cost-effective than game jerseys?

Yes, practice jerseys focus on durability and functionality at budget-friendly prices, making them perfect for teams needing multiple training uniforms.

Can practice jerseys include coach and staff sizing?

Yes, practice jerseys commonly include coaches and support staff to create team unity during practices and help with player identification.

How often do Florida teams typically replace practice jerseys?

Most teams use practice jerseys for a full season or longer, with durability designed to withstand daily use throughout Florida’s extended basketball seasons.

Can practice jerseys be used for scrimmages and informal games?

Absolutely – practice jerseys work well for scrimmages, pickup games, and informal competition while maintaining team coordination and identity.

What colors work best for basketball practice jerseys?

Team colors that coordinate with game uniforms work well, often using alternate shades or simplified color schemes that maintain team identity.

How do practice jerseys support skill development?

By providing consistent team identity and player organization, practice jerseys help create the focused training environment that supports skill development.

Can practice jerseys be part of a complete team uniform program?

Yes, practice jerseys coordinate with game uniforms and other team apparel to create comprehensive team identity across all basketball activities.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

What Your Jersey Is Made Of

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

Select Fabric Type
Primary Fabric
Sublimation Polyester
100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Our athletic mesh fabric features an open-weave construction that maximises air circulation across the body — making it the go-to choice for Florida programs playing in hot gymnasiums or outdoor courts. The open holes in the weave allow heat to escape rapidly, keeping players cooler for longer during high-intensity play. At 120–130 GSM, it is our lightest fabric option.

Our moisture-wicking performance fabric uses a polyester-spandex blend with capillary wicking channels built into the weave. These microscopic channels actively draw sweat away from the skin and push it to the outer surface of the fabric where it can evaporate rapidly. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Send us your roster list with heights and weights and we'll size every player for you — free, as part of your quote.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.
