Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Corporate basketball leagues and social competitions in Florida use sublimated jerseys to incorporate company logos, brand colors, and sponsor names into a custom design. The majority of our orders come from Florida middle schools, high schools, and athletic departments ordering game-day jersey sets for their varsity and JV teams. Sublimated jerseys are the best choice for most situations — but there are a few scenarios where a different product might serve you better. We would rather point you to the right product than have you order something that does not suit your needs.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Basketball Warm Up Jerseys

Basketball warm up jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed specifically for pre-game preparation and training activities across Florida, providing teams with professional-looking layering options that help players prepare mentally and physically for game time while maintaining team identity during warm-up routines. These warm up jerseys use comfortable materials that allow easy movement during stretching, shooting practice, and pre-game drills while providing the flexibility to remove them quickly when game action begins, creating a polished team presentation from the moment players take the court. The warm up design accommodates the unique needs of basketball preparation, including breathable construction for active warm-ups in Florida’s climate, loose fits that work over uniforms, and customization options that reinforce team branding during the crucial moments when players are getting mentally prepared for competition, all supported by our no minimum order commitment, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

Why are warm-up jerseys important for basketball teams?

Warm-up jerseys create professional team presentation during pre-game routines, help players mentally prepare for competition, and provide comfortable layering for stretching and shooting practice.

How do warm-up jerseys help with team psychology?

Matching warm-up jerseys create visual team unity that builds confidence and intimidates opponents, while helping players feel prepared and professional during crucial pre-game moments.

Can warm-up jerseys be worn over game uniforms?

Yes, warm-up jerseys are designed with loose fits that accommodate wearing over game uniforms, allowing easy removal when game time begins.

What customization options work best for warm-up jerseys?

Team names, logos, motivational slogans, and player names work well on warm-up jerseys, reinforcing team identity during the important psychological preparation phase.

How do warm-up jerseys perform in Florida’s climate?

Warm-up jerseys use breathable materials that prevent overheating during active pre-game routines in Florida’s warm gymnasium and outdoor court conditions.

Can warm-up jerseys be used for practice sessions?

Absolutely – warm-up jerseys work excellently for practice, providing comfortable layering for training activities and creating team coordination during skill development.

What’s the difference between warm-up jerseys and practice jerseys?

Warm-up jerseys focus on pre-game presentation and easy removal, while practice jerseys are designed for extended training sessions and may have different fit and durability features.

How do warm-up jerseys coordinate with team uniforms?

Warm-up jerseys typically use team colors and branding that complement game uniforms, creating cohesive team appearance from warm-up through competition.

Can warm-up jerseys include sponsor recognition?

Yes, warm-up jerseys provide excellent visibility for sponsor logos during pre-game activities when crowds and opponents see teams preparing for competition.

What sizes accommodate players wearing uniforms underneath?

Warm-up jerseys use sizing that allows comfortable layering over uniforms, typically ordering one size larger than players’ game jersey size.

How quickly can players remove warm-up jerseys before games?

Warm-up jerseys are designed for quick, easy removal with construction that allows players to shed them efficiently when transitioning to game action.

Do warm-up jerseys work for youth teams in Florida?

Yes, warm-up jerseys help young players feel professional and prepared, building confidence and team pride that contributes to positive youth sports experiences.

Can warm-up jerseys be part of a complete team package?

Warm-up jerseys coordinate with game uniforms, practice gear, and other team apparel to create comprehensive team identity across all basketball activities.

What Is a

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Black Basketball Jersey

Black basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed for teams across Florida who want the classic, intimidating look that black provides while maintaining all the professional performance features competitive basketball demands. Black jerseys offer timeless athletic styling that never goes out of fashion, creating a sleek, powerful team appearance that projects confidence and intensity on the court while providing the moisture-wicking performance and durability needed for serious basketball competition. The black color choice offers exceptional versatility for team coordination, working well with virtually any accent colors and providing excellent contrast for team names, numbers, and logos that create sharp, professional team identity. These jerseys work perfectly for teams that want to project strength and unity through their uniform choices while benefiting from the psychological impact that black uniforms often have on both players and opponents, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

Why are black basketball jerseys a popular choice for Florida teams?

Black jerseys provide timeless, intimidating appearance that projects strength and confidence while offering maximum versatility for team coordination and accent colors.

Do black jerseys get too hot in Florida’s warm climate?

Modern black jerseys use advanced materials with superior moisture-wicking and breathability that help manage heat, though lighter colors may provide slight cooling advantages.

What decoration colors work best with black basketball jerseys?

White, gold, silver, red, and bright colors create excellent contrast with black, making team names, numbers, and logos highly visible and impactful.

Can black jerseys provide psychological advantages during competition?

Many teams find that black jerseys project intimidation and authority, potentially providing psychological benefits while building team confidence and unity.

How do black basketball jerseys maintain their appearance over time?

Quality black jerseys use fade-resistant materials and construction designed to maintain deep black color through frequent washing and extended basketball seasons.

Are black jerseys suitable for all levels of Florida basketball?

Yes, black jerseys work excellently from youth leagues to adult competition, providing professional appearance that elevates any team’s image.

Can black jerseys coordinate effectively with team accessories?

Black jerseys coordinate exceptionally well with shorts, warm-ups, shoes, and accessories in virtually any color combination for comprehensive team identity.

What’s special about black as a basketball uniform color?

Black represents power, sophistication, and intimidation in sports, creating instant visual impact while providing timeless styling that never goes out of fashion.

How do black jerseys photograph and appear on video?

Black jerseys provide excellent contrast for photography and video, making team graphics and player movements highly visible for media coverage.

Can black jerseys include multiple accent colors effectively?

Yes, black serves as an excellent base for multi-color designs, allowing complex graphics and color combinations while maintaining professional appearance.

Do black basketball jerseys work for both home and away games?

Black jerseys can work for either home or away games depending on league requirements, often serving as striking alternate uniforms.

How do black jerseys help with sponsor visibility?

Black backgrounds provide excellent contrast for sponsor logos in white, gold, or bright colors, maximizing sponsor visibility and recognition value.

What care is required to maintain black jersey appearance?

Machine wash cold inside-out to prevent fading, air dry when possible, and use appropriate detergents to maintain the rich black color.

Can black jerseys be enhanced with special effects or finishes?

Yes, black jerseys work well with metallic accents, reflective elements, or special finishes that create unique visual effects while maintaining the black base.

How do black jerseys contribute to team identity and culture?

Black jerseys often reflect team values like strength, determination, and intensity, helping build team culture and identity around powerful competitive attitudes.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What are the benefits of ordering blank basketball jerseys?

Blank jerseys offer lower initial costs, faster delivery, flexibility for future decoration, and the ability to work with local Florida decorators while maintaining the same quality as decorated jerseys.

Can blank jerseys be decorated later with team information?

Yes, blank jerseys are specifically designed to accept all major decoration methods including heat transfer, screen printing, embroidery, and vinyl application.

What colors are available for blank basketball jerseys?

Standard colors include white, black, navy, royal blue, and red, with additional team colors available by request for Florida teams with specific color requirements.

How quickly can blank jerseys be shipped to Florida teams?

Blank jerseys typically ship within 3-5 business days since no decoration is required, making them perfect for urgent needs or last-minute player additions.

Are blank jerseys the same quality as decorated jerseys?

Absolutely – blank jerseys use identical materials, construction, and quality standards as our decorated versions, providing the same performance benefits for Florida basketball.

What’s the best way to use blank jerseys for team coordination?

Blank jerseys work great for practice, backup uniforms, loaner jerseys for new players, or as starter uniforms that can be upgraded with decoration later.

Can we order different colors and sizes in one blank jersey order?

Yes, Florida teams can combine multiple colors and sizes in a single order while maintaining wholesale pricing benefits across the entire order.

How do blank jerseys help with changing team rosters?

Blank jerseys provide flexibility for teams with roster changes, allowing you to add decoration for specific players as needed rather than pre-decorating unused jerseys.

What decoration methods work best with your blank jerseys?

Our blank jerseys work with all decoration methods. Heat transfer is most common for small quantities, while screen printing is cost-effective for larger Florida team orders.

Can local Florida decorators work with your blank jerseys?

Yes, our blank jerseys are compatible with local screen printers and embroidery shops throughout Florida, giving teams flexibility in decoration timing and methods.

What’s the cost difference between blank and decorated jerseys?

Blank jerseys cost less initially, and total cost depends on your decoration method and quantity. Many Florida teams save money using local decorators for large quantities.

How should blank jerseys be stored before decoration?

Store blank jerseys in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight. Keep them clean and wrinkle-free for best decoration results when you’re ready.

Can blank jerseys be used for official games in Florida leagues?

League requirements vary – some allow solid-colored jerseys while others require numbers and team identification. Check your specific league regulations.

What’s the return policy for blank basketball jerseys?

Blank jerseys can be returned within 30 days if unused and in original condition, giving Florida teams confidence in their ordering decisions.

How do we determine the right quantities for blank jersey orders?

Consider your current roster plus 2-3 extra jerseys for new players and replacements. Our team can help Florida coaches plan quantities based on typical roster sizes.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

What Your Jersey Is Made Of

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Our athletic mesh fabric features an open-weave construction that maximises air circulation across the body — making it the go-to choice for Florida programs playing in hot gymnasiums or outdoor courts. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Why are blue basketball jerseys popular with Florida teams?

Blue jerseys provide classic, trustworthy appearance that represents stability and tradition while offering versatile color choice that works well with many team coordination schemes.

What shades of blue work best for basketball jerseys?

Popular options include royal blue, navy blue, sky blue, and custom blue shades that can match school colors or specific team identity requirements.

Can blue jerseys coordinate with traditional basketball color schemes?

Yes, blue works excellently with white, gold, silver, and red, creating classic basketball color combinations that project both tradition and professionalism.

Do blue basketball jerseys provide psychological advantages?

Blue represents trust, stability, and confidence, potentially providing psychological benefits while creating team identity that emphasizes reliability and steady performance.

How do blue jerseys perform in Florida’s basketball environment?

Blue jerseys use performance materials providing moisture-wicking and durability while maintaining rich color appearance in Florida’s demanding athletic conditions.

Are blue jerseys suitable for school and institutional teams?

Blue jerseys work perfectly for school teams and organizations with blue in their color schemes, maintaining institutional identity and brand consistency.

What decoration colors work best with blue basketball jerseys?

White, gold, silver, and yellow create excellent contrast with blue, while red can create patriotic themes and black adds sophisticated accent options.

Can blue jerseys represent patriotic or American themes?

Yes, blue jerseys work excellently for patriotic themes, especially when combined with red and white elements for American flag-inspired team designs.

How do blue jerseys maintain their appearance over time?

Quality blue jerseys use fade-resistant materials and construction designed to maintain rich blue color through frequent washing and extended basketball seasons.

What’s the historical significance of blue in basketball uniforms?

Blue has been a traditional basketball color for decades, representing stability and trust while creating timeless team identity that connects to basketball heritage.

Can blue jerseys include multiple design elements effectively?

Yes, blue serves as an excellent base for complex designs, allowing multiple accent colors and graphics while maintaining professional basketball appearance.

How do blue jerseys contribute to fan loyalty and team tradition?

Blue’s associations with trust and stability often contribute to strong fan loyalty and lasting team traditions built around consistent, reliable team identity.

What care maintains blue jersey color quality?

Machine wash cold inside-out, use color-safe detergents, avoid bleach, and air dry when possible to maintain rich blue color throughout the season.

Can blue jerseys be enhanced with special effects or finishes?

Yes, blue jerseys work well with metallic silver or gold accents, reflective elements, or gradient effects that enhance the classic blue appearance.

How do blue jerseys work for both traditional and modern team identities?

Blue’s versatility allows it to work for traditional, classic team identities while also serving as a strong base for modern, contemporary design approaches.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Green Basketball Jersey

Green basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed for teams across Florida who want the fresh, energetic look that green provides while maintaining all the professional performance features competitive basketball demands. Green jerseys offer vibrant color choice that represents growth, energy, and natural strength, creating dynamic team identity that projects vitality and determination on the court while providing the moisture-wicking performance and durability needed for serious basketball competition. The green color choice works particularly well for teams wanting to represent environmental themes, Irish heritage, or simply the fresh energy that green symbolizes in competitive athletics, while also providing excellent visibility and contrast for team graphics and customization. These jerseys appeal to teams that want distinctive color choices that create memorable identity while benefiting from the psychological associations that green brings – including growth, harmony, and the kind of fresh energy that translates into competitive advantage, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What shades of grey work best for basketball jerseys?

Popular options include light grey, charcoal grey, heather grey, and custom grey shades that can coordinate with modern team identity and branding requirements.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Lightweight Basketball Jerseys

These ultra-light jerseys use cutting-edge fabric technology to minimize weight while maximizing performance benefits, allowing Florida players to move faster, jump higher, and maintain energy longer during competitive basketball action. The lightweight construction doesn’t mean compromise – these jerseys still provide moisture-wicking performance, durability for intense play, and complete customization options for team names, numbers, and logos while giving players the psychological and physical advantage that comes from wearing uniforms that feel almost weightless during crucial game moments, all supported by our no minimum order policy, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting your team both simple and effective.

What makes lightweight basketball jerseys beneficial for performance?

Lightweight jerseys reduce bulk and weight, allowing Florida players to move faster, jump higher, and maintain energy longer while providing the same durability and professional appearance.

How much lighter are lightweight jerseys compared to standard jerseys?

Lightweight jerseys typically weigh 20-30% less than standard jerseys through advanced fiber technology and construction methods that eliminate unnecessary material without sacrificing quality.

Do lightweight jerseys provide the same durability as heavier jerseys?

Yes, lightweight jerseys use advanced materials that provide equal or better durability while weighing significantly less, designed specifically for competitive basketball demands.

Can lightweight jerseys handle Florida’s intense basketball conditions?

Absolutely – lightweight jerseys excel in Florida’s climate by reducing heat retention while providing superior moisture management and breathability for optimal comfort.

What positions benefit most from lightweight basketball jerseys?

All positions benefit, but guards particularly appreciate the enhanced speed and agility, while forwards and centers benefit from reduced fatigue during extended play.

Can lightweight jerseys be customized with team graphics and sponsors?

Yes, lightweight jerseys accept all decoration methods using specialized techniques that maintain the weight advantage while providing clear, professional team branding.

How do lightweight jerseys affect player psychology and confidence?

Many players report feeling faster and more agile in lightweight jerseys, providing psychological benefits that can translate into improved performance and confidence.

Are lightweight jerseys more expensive than standard jerseys?

Lightweight jerseys may cost slightly more due to advanced materials and specialized construction, but many Florida teams find the performance benefits justify the investment.

Do lightweight jerseys work well for tournament play?

Lightweight jerseys are excellent for tournaments, helping players maintain energy through multiple games and providing competitive advantages during intensive competition.

How do lightweight jerseys help with player fatigue?

By reducing the weight players carry, lightweight jerseys can decrease overall fatigue, particularly during long games or practices in Florida’s demanding conditions.

Can lightweight jerseys be worn for both practice and games?

Yes, lightweight jerseys provide consistent performance benefits for both practice and games, giving Florida teams advantages across all basketball activities.

What’s the feel difference between lightweight and regular jerseys?

Lightweight jerseys feel noticeably less bulky and more breathable, with many players describing them as feeling ‘barely there’ during play.

How do you care for lightweight basketball jerseys?

Lightweight jerseys require gentle care – machine wash cold, air dry recommended – and the advanced materials maintain their lightweight properties with proper care.

Do lightweight jerseys work for recreational teams or just elite players?

Lightweight jerseys benefit players at all levels, from recreational leagues to elite competition, providing performance advantages that any Florida team can appreciate.

What’s the sizing approach for lightweight basketball jerseys?

Lightweight jerseys use athletic fits optimized for the reduced material weight, and we provide specific sizing guidance to ensure Florida teams get the perfect performance fit.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

These ultra-light basketball shirts use cutting-edge fabric technology to minimize weight while maximizing performance benefits, allowing Florida players to move faster and maintain energy longer during training sessions, pickup games, and competitive play. The lightweight construction doesn’t mean compromise – these shirts still provide moisture-wicking performance, breathable construction, and complete customization options for team names, logos, and player identification while giving athletes the psychological and physical advantage that comes from wearing athletic wear that feels almost weightless during crucial moments. This shirt design works perfectly as standalone athletic wear or as part of comprehensive team coordination, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting players both effective and affordable.

What makes lightweight basketball shirts beneficial for performance?

Lightweight shirts reduce bulk and weight, allowing Florida players to move faster, maintain energy longer, and experience enhanced agility while providing the same athletic performance features.

How much lighter are these shirts compared to regular basketball shirts?

Lightweight basketball shirts typically weigh 20-30% less than standard shirts through advanced fiber technology and construction methods that eliminate unnecessary weight.

Do lightweight shirts provide the same durability as heavier shirts?

Yes, lightweight shirts use advanced materials that provide equal or better durability while weighing significantly less, designed for demanding basketball activities.

Can lightweight shirts handle Florida’s warm climate effectively?

Absolutely – lightweight shirts excel in Florida’s climate by reducing heat retention while providing superior moisture management and breathability.

What basketball activities benefit most from lightweight shirts?

All basketball activities benefit, but training, conditioning, pickup games, and competitive play particularly benefit from the enhanced speed and reduced fatigue.

Can lightweight basketball shirts be customized with team branding?

Yes, lightweight shirts accept all decoration methods using specialized techniques that maintain the weight advantage while providing clear team identification.

How do lightweight shirts affect player psychology and confidence?

Many players report feeling faster and more agile in lightweight shirts, providing psychological benefits that can translate into improved performance.

Are lightweight basketball shirts suitable for team coordination?

Yes, lightweight shirts can include team colors, names, logos, and design elements that create team identity while providing performance benefits.

What’s the feel difference between lightweight and regular basketball shirts?

Lightweight shirts feel noticeably less bulky and more breathable, with many players describing them as feeling ‘barely there’ during active play.

How do you care for lightweight basketball shirts?

Lightweight shirts require gentle care – machine wash cold, air dry recommended – and the advanced materials maintain their lightweight properties with proper care.

Do lightweight shirts work for recreational and competitive play?

Lightweight shirts benefit players at all levels, from casual pickup games to competitive leagues, providing performance advantages any Florida player can appreciate.

Can lightweight basketball shirts be layered with other apparel?

Yes, the lightweight construction makes these shirts excellent for layering under other team apparel without adding bulk or restricting movement.

What colors and designs work best for lightweight basketball shirts?

All team colors work well, though lighter colors may provide additional cooling benefits when combined with the lightweight construction for Florida play.

How do lightweight shirts help with player fatigue during long sessions?

By reducing the weight players carry, lightweight shirts can decrease overall fatigue, particularly during extended training or competitive play in Florida’s demanding conditions.

What makes lightweight basketball shirts a good investment for Florida teams?

Lightweight shirts provide performance advantages that can enhance player speed, reduce fatigue, and contribute to competitive success while maintaining professional team appearance.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

What Your Jersey Is Made Of

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

Primary Fabric
Sublimation Polyester
100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Our athletic mesh fabric features an open-weave construction that maximises air circulation across the body — making it the go-to choice for Florida programs playing in hot gymnasiums or outdoor courts. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

What makes lightweight basketball shorts beneficial for performance?

Lightweight shorts reduce bulk and weight, allowing Florida players to move faster, jump higher, and maintain energy longer while providing the same athletic performance and durability features.

How much lighter are these shorts compared to regular basketball shorts?

Lightweight basketball shorts typically weigh 25-35% less than standard shorts through advanced fiber technology and construction methods that eliminate unnecessary weight.

Do lightweight shorts provide the same durability as heavier shorts?

Yes, lightweight shorts use advanced materials that provide equal or better durability while weighing significantly less, designed for demanding basketball activities.

Can lightweight shorts handle Florida’s intense basketball conditions?

Absolutely – lightweight shorts excel in Florida’s climate by reducing heat retention while providing superior moisture management and breathability for optimal comfort.

What basketball activities benefit most from lightweight shorts?

All activities benefit, but competitive games, intensive training, and conditioning work particularly benefit from the enhanced speed and reduced fatigue.

Can lightweight basketball shorts be customized with team branding?

Yes, lightweight shorts accept all decoration methods using specialized techniques that maintain the weight advantage while providing clear team identification.

How do lightweight shorts affect player psychology and performance?

Many players report feeling faster and more agile in lightweight shorts, providing psychological benefits that can translate into improved athletic performance.

Are lightweight basketball shorts suitable for competitive play?

Absolutely – lightweight shorts are designed for competitive basketball and provide performance advantages that benefit serious players at all levels of Florida competition.

What’s the feel difference between lightweight and regular basketball shorts?

Lightweight shorts feel noticeably less bulky and more breathable, with many players describing them as feeling ‘barely there’ during active basketball play.

How do you care for lightweight basketball shorts?

Lightweight shorts require gentle care – machine wash cold, air dry recommended – and the advanced materials maintain their lightweight properties with proper maintenance.

Do lightweight shorts work for both games and practice?

Yes, lightweight shorts provide consistent performance benefits for both competitive games and practice sessions, giving Florida teams advantages across all basketball activities.

Can lightweight basketball shorts coordinate with other team apparel?

Yes, lightweight shorts can coordinate with jerseys, shirts, and other team gear using consistent colors and branding for complete team coordination.

How do lightweight shorts help with player fatigue during long games?

By reducing the weight players carry, lightweight shorts can decrease overall fatigue, particularly during extended games or tournament play common in Florida basketball.

What makes lightweight basketball shorts worth the investment?

The performance advantages, reduced fatigue, and enhanced agility that come from lightweight construction can contribute to competitive success while maintaining professional team appearance.

Are lightweight shorts suitable for youth and adult players?

Lightweight shorts benefit players of all ages, from youth leagues to adult competition, providing performance advantages that any Florida basketball player can appreciate and utilize.

What Is a
Sublimated

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.
