When are long sleeve basketball jerseys most beneficial?

Long sleeve jerseys work great for air-conditioned gyms, outdoor winter games, early morning practices, or teams that simply prefer the extended coverage and unique long-sleeve basketball look.

Do long sleeves affect basketball performance and movement?

Modern long sleeve basketball jerseys use flexible materials and athletic cuts that allow full range of motion for shooting, passing, and defensive movements without restriction.

How do long sleeve jerseys handle Florida’s varying climate conditions?

Long sleeve jerseys provide versatility for Florida teams, offering warmth when needed while using moisture-wicking materials that prevent overheating during intense play.

What additional customization options do long sleeves provide?

Long sleeves offer extra space for sleeve graphics, extended team names, additional sponsor placement, or creative design elements not possible on sleeveless jerseys.

Are long sleeve basketball jerseys suitable for competitive play?

Yes, long sleeve jerseys meet competitive basketball requirements and provide professional appearance while offering the performance benefits players need for serious competition.

How do long sleeve jerseys work for youth teams in Florida?

Youth players often prefer long sleeves for the extra coverage and distinctive look, plus parents appreciate the additional protection during active play and varying conditions.

Can long sleeve jerseys include numbers and names on the sleeves?

Absolutely – long sleeves provide excellent space for player numbers, names, or other graphics that enhance team identity and player recognition.

What materials work best for long sleeve basketball jerseys?

Lightweight, breathable polyester blends provide the best combination of coverage, moisture management, and flexibility for long sleeve basketball performance.

Do long sleeve jerseys cost more than sleeveless versions?

Long sleeve jerseys may cost slightly more due to additional material and decoration area, but the price difference is typically minimal for the added functionality.

How do you determine proper sleeve length for basketball jerseys?

Long sleeve basketball jerseys typically extend to the wrist area, providing full arm coverage while maintaining the mobility needed for basketball movements.

Can long sleeve jerseys be worn as standalone uniforms?

Yes, long sleeve jerseys work as complete uniforms or can be layered with other team apparel, giving Florida teams flexibility in their uniform combinations.

What decoration methods work best on long sleeve basketball jerseys?

Screen printing and heat transfer both work excellently on long sleeves, with decoration coordinated between body and sleeve areas for cohesive team appearance.

How do long sleeve jerseys work for outdoor basketball in Florida?

Long sleeves provide sun protection for outdoor play while still offering breathability and moisture management for Florida’s outdoor basketball conditions.

Can teams mix long sleeve and sleeveless jerseys?

While possible, teams typically choose consistent sleeve lengths for uniform appearance, though long sleeves can be used for specific positions or conditions if desired.

What’s the care process for long sleeve basketball jerseys?

Machine wash cold inside-out to protect sleeve decoration, air dry when possible, and the extended fabric areas will maintain their appearance with proper care.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Long Sleeve Basketball Shirt

Long sleeve basketball shirts from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed for players across Florida who need extended coverage and versatility in their athletic wear, perfect for cooler conditions, outdoor play with sun protection, or simply players who prefer the distinctive long-sleeve basketball aesthetic while maintaining all the performance features basketball demands. These long sleeve basketball shirts provide comprehensive arm coverage while still delivering moisture-wicking performance and breathability that keeps Florida players comfortable during various basketball activities, from early morning practices to evening games when temperatures drop. The extended sleeve design offers additional real estate for creative customization including team names, player information, and logos, while providing the flexibility to work as standalone athletic wear or as layering pieces under other team apparel, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting players both comprehensive and affordable.

When are long sleeve basketball shirts most beneficial?

Long sleeve shirts work great for cooler weather, air-conditioned gyms, outdoor games with sun exposure, or players who prefer comprehensive arm coverage during basketball activities.

How do long sleeve shirts perform in Florida’s varying conditions?

Long sleeve basketball shirts provide adaptability for Florida’s climate changes, offering coverage when needed while using breathable materials that prevent overheating.

Can long sleeve basketball shirts be used for sun protection?

Yes, long sleeves provide excellent sun protection for outdoor basketball, helping Florida players avoid sun exposure during extended outdoor play and practice.

What additional customization options do long sleeves provide?

Long sleeves offer extra space for sleeve graphics, extended team names, player information, or design elements not possible on sleeveless options.

Are long sleeve basketball shirts suitable for layering?

Absolutely – long sleeve shirts work well as base layers under other team apparel or as standalone pieces, providing flexible options for various conditions.

How do long sleeve shirts accommodate different basketball activities?

Long sleeve shirts work for practice, casual play, training, and situations where players want coverage while maintaining basketball-specific performance features.

Can long sleeve basketball shirts include team coordination elements?

Yes, long sleeve shirts can feature team colors, names, logos, and design elements that create team identity across various basketball activities.

What makes long sleeve basketball shirts different from regular long sleeve shirts?

Basketball shirts use athletic cuts, performance materials, and construction specifically designed for basketball movement and court activities.

How do long sleeve shirts benefit youth basketball players?

Youth players often appreciate the additional coverage, and parents value the sun protection and versatility long sleeves provide for active young athletes.

Can long sleeve basketball shirts work for multiple sports?

While designed for basketball, long sleeve shirts work well for other athletic activities, giving Florida athletes versatile performance wear.

What decoration methods work best on long sleeve basketball shirts?

Screen printing, heat transfer, and embroidery all work excellently on long sleeves, with decoration coordinated between body and sleeve areas.

How do long sleeve shirts help with temperature regulation?

Long sleeve shirts provide coverage when cool while using moisture-wicking materials that help regulate temperature during active basketball play.

Are long sleeve basketball shirts more expensive than short sleeve options?

Long sleeve shirts may cost slightly more due to additional material and decoration area, but the difference is typically minimal for the added functionality.

Can long sleeve basketball shirts be part of complete team apparel?

Yes, long sleeve shirts coordinate with shorts, warm-ups, and other team gear to create comprehensive team identity across basketball activities.

How do long sleeve basketball shirts appeal to different playing preferences?

Long sleeve shirts appeal to players who want coverage, distinctive styling, or need versatile athletic wear that works across various basketball situations.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. Our athletic mesh fabric features an open-weave construction that maximises air circulation across the body — making it the go-to choice for Florida programs playing in hot gymnasiums or outdoor courts. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Mesh Basketball Jerseys

Mesh basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys engineered specifically for maximum ventilation and cooling performance, featuring advanced mesh construction that provides superior airflow and breathability perfect for Florida’s warm climate and intense basketball competition. These mesh jerseys use lightweight, open-weave materials that allow air to circulate freely while maintaining the durability and professional appearance that competitive basketball demands, making them the ideal choice for Florida teams who need optimal temperature management during long games, intensive practices, and tournament play in challenging conditions. The mesh construction doesn’t compromise customization options – you still get complete team personalization with names, numbers, and logos while benefiting from enhanced cooling that helps players maintain peak performance when the competition heats up, all supported by our no minimum order commitment, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

What makes mesh basketball jerseys ideal for Florida teams?

Mesh jerseys provide maximum ventilation and cooling through open-weave construction, making them perfect for Florida’s warm climate and intense basketball competition.

How do mesh jerseys compare to regular jerseys for cooling?

Mesh jerseys offer significantly better airflow and heat dissipation than solid fabrics, helping Florida players stay cooler and maintain energy throughout games and practices.

Are mesh basketball jerseys durable enough for competitive play?

Yes, modern mesh jerseys use reinforced construction and durable materials designed to withstand the demands of competitive basketball while maintaining superior ventilation.

Can mesh jerseys be customized with team names and numbers?

Absolutely – mesh jerseys accept all standard decoration methods with techniques adapted for mesh construction, ensuring team branding shows clearly through the material.

Do mesh jerseys work well for outdoor basketball in Florida?

Mesh jerseys excel for outdoor play, providing maximum cooling during sunny conditions while allowing sweat to evaporate quickly in Florida’s humid environment.

How do mesh jerseys perform during intensive tournament play?

Mesh jerseys help players stay cool during back-to-back tournament games, reducing fatigue from overheating and maintaining comfort through long competition days.

What’s the difference between mesh and moisture-wicking jerseys?

Mesh jerseys use open-weave construction for direct airflow, while moisture-wicking focuses on fabric treatment. Mesh provides more aggressive cooling for extreme conditions.

Can mesh jerseys include sponsor logos and complex graphics?

Yes, modern decoration techniques work excellently with mesh materials, allowing sponsor recognition and team graphics while maintaining the cooling benefits.

How do mesh jerseys help with player comfort during long practices?

The enhanced ventilation reduces heat buildup during extended practice sessions, helping Florida players stay comfortable and focused throughout intensive training.

Are mesh jerseys suitable for all basketball positions?

Yes, mesh jerseys benefit all positions by providing cooling relief, though they’re especially valuable for players who generate significant heat during active play.

What colors work best for mesh basketball jerseys?

Lighter colors like white, light gray, and light blue provide additional cooling benefits with mesh construction, though all team colors are available.

How do you care for mesh basketball jerseys?

Mesh jerseys are machine washable in cold water, air dry recommended to maintain mesh structure, and the open construction helps them dry quickly.

Can mesh jerseys be worn as practice and game uniforms?

Yes, mesh jerseys work excellently for both practice and games, giving Florida teams consistent cooling benefits and professional appearance across all activities.

Do mesh jerseys feel different than regular basketball jerseys?

Mesh jerseys feel lighter and more breathable, with the open construction providing immediate cooling sensation that many Florida players prefer.

What’s the ordering timeline for mesh basketball jerseys?

Mesh jerseys require 10-14 business days with specialized production techniques, and we recommend ordering early for Florida’s basketball season to ensure availability.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

What makes mesh basketball shorts ideal for Florida teams?

Mesh shorts provide maximum ventilation and cooling through open-weave construction, making them perfect for Florida’s warm climate and intense basketball competition where heat management is critical.

How do mesh shorts compare to regular shorts for cooling performance?

Mesh shorts offer significantly better airflow and heat dissipation than solid fabrics, helping Florida players stay cooler and maintain energy throughout games and practices.

Are mesh basketball shorts durable enough for competitive play?

Yes, modern mesh shorts use reinforced construction and durable materials designed to withstand the demands of competitive basketball while maintaining superior ventilation.

Can mesh shorts be customized with team names and graphics?

Absolutely – mesh shorts accept all standard decoration methods with techniques adapted for mesh construction, ensuring team branding shows clearly through the material.

Do mesh shorts work well for outdoor basketball in Florida?

Mesh shorts excel for outdoor play, providing maximum cooling during sunny conditions while allowing sweat to evaporate quickly in Florida’s humid environment.

How do mesh shorts perform during intensive tournament play?

Mesh shorts help players stay cool during back-to-back tournament games, reducing fatigue from overheating and maintaining comfort through long competition days.

What’s the difference between mesh shorts and moisture-wicking shorts?

Mesh shorts use open-weave construction for direct airflow cooling, while moisture-wicking focuses on fabric treatment. Mesh provides more aggressive cooling for extreme conditions.

Can mesh shorts include team coordination and sponsor elements?

Yes, modern decoration techniques work excellently with mesh materials, allowing team coordination and sponsor recognition while maintaining the cooling benefits.

How do mesh shorts help with player comfort during long practices?

The enhanced ventilation reduces heat buildup during extended practice sessions, helping Florida players stay comfortable and focused throughout intensive training.

Are mesh shorts suitable for all basketball positions?

Yes, mesh shorts benefit all positions by providing cooling relief, though they’re especially valuable for players who generate significant heat during active play.

What colors work best for mesh basketball shorts?

Lighter colors like white, light gray, and light blue provide additional cooling benefits with mesh construction, though all team colors are available with mesh materials.

How do you care for mesh basketball shorts?

Mesh shorts are machine washable in cold water, air dry recommended to maintain mesh structure, and the open construction helps them dry quickly after washing.

Can mesh shorts be worn for both practice and competitive games?

Yes, mesh shorts work excellently for both practice and games, giving Florida teams consistent cooling benefits and professional appearance across all basketball activities.

Do mesh shorts feel different than regular basketball shorts?

Mesh shorts feel lighter and more breathable, with the open construction providing immediate cooling sensation that many Florida players prefer during active play.

What’s the ordering timeline for mesh basketball shorts?

Mesh shorts require 10-14 business days with specialized production techniques, and we recommend ordering early for Florida’s basketball season to ensure cooling benefits are available.

What Is a
Sublimated

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

What makes mesh tank tops the ultimate cooling solution for Florida basketball?

Mesh tank tops combine sleeveless design with open-weave mesh construction, providing maximum ventilation and cooling perfect for Florida’s demanding basketball conditions.

How do mesh tank tops compare to regular tank tops for cooling?

Mesh tank tops provide significantly better airflow and heat dissipation than solid tank tops, offering the ultimate cooling solution for Florida’s warm, humid basketball environment.

Are mesh basketball tank tops durable enough for competitive play?

Yes, modern mesh tank tops use reinforced construction and durable materials designed to withstand competitive basketball while providing superior cooling performance.

Can mesh tank tops be customized with team names and graphics?

Absolutely – mesh tank tops accept all decoration methods with techniques adapted for mesh construction, ensuring team branding shows clearly while maintaining cooling benefits.

Do mesh tank tops work well for outdoor basketball in Florida?

Mesh tank tops excel for outdoor play, providing maximum cooling during sunny conditions while allowing excellent airflow in Florida’s humid outdoor environment.

How do mesh tank tops perform during intensive tournament play?

Mesh tank tops help players stay cool during back-to-back tournament games, reducing fatigue from overheating while maintaining comfort through long competition days.

What’s the difference between mesh tank tops and moisture-wicking tank tops?

Mesh tank tops use open-weave construction for direct airflow cooling, while moisture-wicking focuses on sweat transport. Mesh provides more aggressive cooling for extreme conditions.

Can mesh tank tops include team coordination and sponsor elements?

Yes, modern decoration techniques work excellently with mesh tank tops, allowing team coordination and sponsor recognition while maintaining superior cooling benefits.

How do mesh tank tops help with player comfort during extended practices?

The enhanced ventilation and sleeveless design reduce heat buildup during long practice sessions, helping Florida players stay comfortable and focused throughout training.

Are mesh tank tops suitable for all basketball positions?

Yes, mesh tank tops benefit all positions by providing ultimate cooling relief, though they’re especially valuable for players who generate significant heat during active play.

What colors work best for mesh basketball tank tops?

Lighter colors like white, light gray, and light blue provide additional cooling benefits with mesh construction, though all team colors are available with mesh materials.

How do you care for mesh basketball tank tops?

Mesh tank tops are machine washable in cold water, air dry recommended to maintain mesh structure, and the open construction helps them dry quickly after washing.

Can mesh tank tops be worn for both practice and competitive games?

Yes, mesh tank tops work excellently for both practice and games, giving Florida teams consistent ultimate cooling benefits across all basketball activities.

Do mesh tank tops feel different than regular tank tops?

Mesh tank tops feel lighter and significantly more breathable, with the open construction providing immediate cooling sensation that Florida players particularly appreciate.

What makes mesh tank tops worth the investment for Florida teams?

The superior cooling performance, reduced fatigue from overheating, and enhanced comfort during Florida’s demanding basketball conditions make mesh tank tops valuable for serious teams.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Moisture Wicking Basketball Shirt

Moisture wicking basketball shirts from Florida Basketball Jerseys engineered specifically for Florida’s demanding climate and intense basketball action, featuring advanced moisture management technology that pulls sweat away from the body and facilitates rapid evaporation to keep players dry, comfortable, and focused during the most challenging conditions. These high-performance shirts use specialized fibers and construction techniques that actively transport moisture from the skin to the fabric surface where it can evaporate quickly, preventing the discomfort and performance reduction that comes with excess moisture buildup during intensive basketball activities. The moisture-wicking design makes these shirts ideal for Florida’s year-round basketball culture, from summer outdoor courts to humid gymnasium conditions, providing players with the comfort and confidence that comes from staying dry during crucial moments of competition, training, and skill development, complete with customization options for team identity and all supported by our no minimum order policy, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

How does moisture-wicking technology work in basketball shirts?

Moisture-wicking fibers actively transport sweat away from the skin to the fabric surface where it evaporates quickly, keeping Florida players dry and comfortable during intense play.

What makes moisture-wicking shirts essential for Florida basketball?

Florida’s warm, humid climate makes moisture management critical for player comfort and performance, with wicking technology preventing sweat buildup that can cause discomfort.

How quickly do moisture-wicking shirts dry compared to regular shirts?

Moisture-wicking shirts dry significantly faster than regular materials, often within minutes of completing basketball activity, maintaining comfort throughout play.

Can moisture-wicking basketball shirts prevent overheating?

Yes, by rapidly removing sweat and facilitating evaporation, moisture-wicking shirts help maintain body temperature regulation during intensive basketball activities.

Do moisture-wicking shirts work for both indoor and outdoor basketball?

Absolutely – moisture-wicking benefits apply to all basketball environments, from air-conditioned gyms to Florida’s outdoor courts in summer heat.

How do moisture-wicking shirts perform during tournament play?

Moisture-wicking shirts excel during tournaments, helping players stay comfortable through multiple games and extended play periods common in competitive basketball.

Can moisture-wicking basketball shirts be customized with team graphics?

Yes, moisture-wicking shirts accept all decoration methods with techniques that preserve the wicking properties while providing clear team identification.

What’s the difference between moisture-wicking and regular basketball shirts?

Moisture-wicking shirts use specialized fibers that actively transport sweat, while regular shirts may absorb moisture without the rapid transport and evaporation benefits.

How do moisture-wicking shirts help with player confidence?

By keeping players dry and comfortable, moisture-wicking shirts allow athletes to focus on performance rather than discomfort, enhancing confidence during crucial moments.

Are moisture-wicking basketball shirts suitable for intense training?

Yes, moisture-wicking shirts are ideal for intensive training sessions, conditioning workouts, and any high-sweat basketball activities common in Florida programs.

How do you care for moisture-wicking basketball shirts?

Machine wash cold with performance detergents, avoid fabric softeners that can impair wicking properties, and air dry to maintain moisture management features.

Do moisture-wicking shirts work for all basketball positions?

Yes, all positions benefit from moisture management, though players who generate more heat during active play particularly appreciate the wicking benefits.

Can moisture-wicking shirts be worn as everyday athletic wear?

While designed for basketball, moisture-wicking shirts work excellently for other athletic activities, providing Florida athletes with versatile performance wear.

How do moisture-wicking shirts perform in Florida’s humidity?

Moisture-wicking technology is especially beneficial in humid conditions, actively moving sweat away from the body even when evaporation rates are slower.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What makes orange basketball jerseys appealing for Florida teams?

Orange jerseys create vibrant, energetic team identity that projects enthusiasm and creativity while providing distinctive appearance that helps teams stand out during competition.

What shades of orange work best for basketball jerseys?

Popular options include bright orange, burnt orange, and custom orange shades that can coordinate with school colors or specific team identity requirements.

Can orange jerseys coordinate with traditional basketball colors?

Orange works excellently with black, white, navy, and blue, creating energetic combinations that emphasize the enthusiastic competitive spirit of orange.

Do orange basketball jerseys provide psychological advantages?

Orange represents enthusiasm, creativity, and high energy, potentially providing psychological benefits while creating team identity that emphasizes excitement and positive energy.

How do orange jerseys perform in Florida’s basketball environment?

Orange jerseys use performance materials with UV protection and fade resistance, maintaining vibrant appearance while providing athletic performance in Florida’s conditions.

Are orange jerseys suitable for school teams with orange colors?

Yes, orange jerseys work perfectly for schools and organizations with orange in their color schemes, maintaining institutional identity and brand consistency.

What decoration colors work best with orange basketball jerseys?

Black, white, navy, and blue create excellent contrast with orange, while yellow can create energetic combinations that emphasize the vibrant theme.

Can orange jerseys support safety or visibility themes?

Orange jerseys provide excellent visibility and can support safety themes or high-visibility team concepts while maintaining professional athletic appearance.

How do orange jerseys stand out during tournament play?

Orange jerseys create bold visual impact that helps teams stand out during tournaments while projecting the energy and enthusiasm needed for competitive success.

What’s the symbolism of orange in competitive athletics?

Orange represents enthusiasm, creativity, and determination, making it powerful for teams wanting to project energetic, innovative competitive approaches.

Can orange jerseys include creative design elements effectively?

Yes, orange provides excellent background for creative graphics, flame effects, or artistic elements that reinforce the energetic, creative theme.

How do orange jerseys photograph and appear in media coverage?

Orange jerseys provide vibrant appearance that stands out in photography and video coverage, creating memorable visual impact for team recognition.

What care maintains orange jersey color vibrancy over time?

Machine wash cold inside-out, use color-safe detergents, avoid bleach, and air dry when possible to maintain bright orange color throughout seasons.

Can orange jerseys be enhanced with special effects or finishes?

Yes, orange jerseys work well with black accents, flame graphics, or energetic design elements that enhance the vibrant, enthusiastic orange theme.

How do orange jerseys contribute to exciting team culture and energy?

Orange’s associations with enthusiasm and creativity often contribute to positive team culture focused on energy, innovation, and exciting competitive basketball.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Hemmed Armholes

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Pink Basketball Jerseys

Pink basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed for teams across Florida who want to make a bold, distinctive statement on the court while supporting causes, creating unique team identity, or simply embracing the vibrant energy that pink represents in competitive basketball. These pink jerseys combine eye-catching color with professional-grade construction and performance features, proving that bold color choices don’t compromise athletic functionality or team credibility during serious competition. The pink color option opens up creative possibilities for team coordination, sponsor partnerships with awareness campaigns, and the kind of memorable team identity that gets people talking while still delivering the moisture-wicking performance, durability, and customization options that Florida basketball teams need for competitive success, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes distinctive team outfitting both accessible and affordable.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

These plain jerseys work perfectly for teams that prefer understated elegance, recreational leagues with simple uniform requirements, or organizations looking for cost-effective uniform solutions that still project a professional image on the court. The straightforward design approach doesn’t compromise on quality – you get the same moisture-wicking materials, durable construction, and Florida-focused service including no minimum orders, free design consultation, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting your team simple and affordable while ensuring every player gets a jersey that performs as well as it looks.

What makes plain basketball jerseys different from decorated jerseys?

Plain jerseys focus on clean, simple aesthetics with solid colors and minimal decoration, perfect for Florida teams that prefer classic basketball styling without complex graphics.

Are plain jerseys suitable for competitive basketball leagues?

Yes, plain jerseys work well for competitive play and meet most league requirements, while providing professional appearance that Florida teams can be proud of.

What customization options are available for plain jerseys?

Plain jerseys can include team names, player numbers, and simple logos using clean fonts and standard placement that maintains the understated aesthetic.

How do plain jerseys help with team budget management?

Plain jerseys typically cost less due to simplified decoration, making them perfect for Florida teams looking for professional appearance at budget-friendly prices.

Can plain jerseys still include sponsor recognition?

Yes, sponsor logos can be added in simple, clean placements that complement the plain jersey aesthetic while helping Florida teams offset costs.

What color options work best for plain basketball jerseys?

Classic basketball colors like white, black, navy, royal blue, and red work excellently for plain jerseys, creating timeless looks that never go out of style.

Do plain jerseys use the same quality materials as decorated jerseys?

Absolutely – plain jerseys use identical performance materials with moisture-wicking and durability features, ensuring Florida teams get professional quality.

How do plain jerseys appeal to recreational league teams?

Plain jerseys provide professional appearance without complexity, perfect for recreational leagues in Florida that want to look good while keeping costs manageable.

What’s the fastest production time for plain basketball jerseys?

Plain jerseys typically require 7-10 business days due to simplified decoration, making them ideal for Florida teams with tight deadlines.

Can plain jerseys be enhanced with additional decoration later?

Yes, plain jerseys can serve as a foundation for future decoration additions, allowing Florida teams to upgrade their look as budgets permit.

How do plain jerseys work for youth teams in Florida?

Plain jerseys are perfect for youth teams, providing clean professional appearance that parents appreciate while keeping costs reasonable for family budgets.

What decoration methods work best for maintaining the plain aesthetic?

Heat transfer and screen printing in single colors work well for plain jerseys, maintaining the clean look while providing necessary team identification.

Can different positions have different plain jersey styles?

While possible, plain jerseys work best when all team members wear consistent styling to maintain the clean, unified appearance that defines the plain aesthetic.

How do plain jerseys perform in Florida’s warm climate?

Plain jerseys use the same moisture-wicking and breathable materials as all our jerseys, ensuring Florida players stay comfortable during games and practices.

What’s the ordering process for plain basketball jerseys?

Submit your team’s color preferences and basic decoration needs. We’ll create simple, clean designs that maintain the plain aesthetic your Florida team wants.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork.
