Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.

Reversible jerseys provide home and away uniforms in one piece, cutting uniform costs in half while giving Florida teams maximum flexibility for practice scrimmages and tournament play.

We decorate both sides with coordinated team names, player numbers, and logos using colors that complement each side’s base color for professional appearance either way.

Coaches love reversible jerseys for scrimmages, dividing players into teams instantly by having them wear different sides, eliminating the need for separate practice pinnies.

Submit your requirements including both color preferences and decoration needs. We’ll create digital proofs showing both sides before production to ensure your Florida team gets exactly what you want.

Are reversible jerseys more expensive than regular jerseys?

Machine wash cold inside-out to protect both sides’ decoration, air dry when possible, and both sides will maintain their appearance throughout the season.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Reversible Basketball Uniforms

Reversible basketball uniforms from Florida Basketball Jerseys providing complete team outfitting solutions that deliver both home and away looks in a single uniform set, offering Florida teams maximum versatility and exceptional value through innovative two-in-one construction that maintains professional appearance while dramatically reducing uniform costs and logistical complexity. These reversible uniforms include both jerseys and shorts with coordinated color schemes on each side, allowing teams to flip their entire look instantly while maintaining complete team coordination from top to bottom throughout games, tournaments, and practice scrimmages. The reversible approach solves common team challenges including budget constraints, travel logistics, and the need for multiple uniform sets, while providing complete customization options for team names, player numbers, and logos on both sides, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes comprehensive team outfitting both practical and affordable for Florida basketball programs.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Short Sleeve Basketball Jerseys

Short sleeve basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys providing teams across Florida with a modern twist on traditional basketball uniforms, combining the coverage and comfort of sleeves with the mobility and ventilation that competitive basketball demands. These short sleeve jerseys offer the perfect balance between traditional sleeveless designs and full long sleeves, providing shoulder and upper arm coverage that many players prefer while maintaining the cooling and movement benefits that Florida’s warm climate and intense basketball action require. The short sleeve design creates a distinctive look that helps teams stand out while offering additional real estate for creative customization including team names, player numbers, and logos, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting your team both simple and affordable.

What makes short sleeve basketball jerseys a good compromise?

Short sleeve jerseys provide upper arm coverage that many players prefer while maintaining better cooling and mobility than long sleeves, perfect for Florida’s basketball climate.

How do short sleeves compare to traditional sleeveless basketball jerseys?

Short sleeves offer additional coverage and a modern look while preserving most of the cooling and movement benefits that make sleeveless jerseys popular in basketball.

Are short sleeve jerseys suitable for competitive basketball?

Yes, short sleeve jerseys meet competitive basketball requirements and provide professional appearance while offering contemporary styling that helps teams stand out.

What customization options work well on short sleeve jerseys?

Short sleeves provide space for sleeve numbers or graphics while maintaining all traditional decoration areas, giving Florida teams more creative customization options.

How do short sleeve jerseys perform in Florida’s warm climate?

Short sleeves provide better ventilation than long sleeves while offering more coverage than sleeveless, creating an ideal balance for Florida’s basketball conditions.

Do short sleeve jerseys appeal to younger players?

Yes, youth players often prefer the modern look of short sleeves, and the additional coverage appeals to parents while maintaining the performance benefits young athletes need.

Can short sleeve jerseys include team logos on the sleeves?

Absolutely – short sleeves provide excellent space for team logos, sponsor recognition, or decorative elements that enhance team identity and visual impact.

What’s the difference between short sleeve and t-shirt style jerseys?

Short sleeve basketball jerseys use athletic cuts and performance materials designed for basketball movement, while t-shirt styles may be more casual or training-oriented.

How do short sleeve jerseys work for different basketball positions?

Short sleeves work well for all positions, providing the coverage some players prefer while maintaining the mobility that guards, forwards, and centers need for their specific roles.

Are short sleeve jerseys more popular with certain age groups?

Short sleeve jerseys appeal to players who want a contemporary look while maintaining traditional basketball functionality, popular across all age groups in Florida.

Can short sleeve jerseys be part of a complete uniform set?

Yes, short sleeve jerseys coordinate well with basketball shorts and other team apparel to create complete uniform sets that project modern, professional team identity.

What decoration methods work best for short sleeve basketball jerseys?

Heat transfer, screen printing, and embroidery all work excellently on short sleeves, with decoration coordinated between sleeve and body areas for cohesive appearance.

How do short sleeve jerseys help with team recognition?

The distinctive short sleeve look helps Florida teams stand out visually while providing additional space for team names, logos, and other identifying elements.

Do short sleeve jerseys require different sizing than sleeveless?

Short sleeve jerseys may fit slightly differently due to sleeve construction, and we provide specific sizing guidance to ensure proper fit for Florida teams.

Can short sleeve jerseys work for both indoor and outdoor basketball?

Yes, short sleeves provide versatility for both indoor gym play and outdoor courts, offering appropriate coverage while maintaining cooling for varied playing conditions.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

These traditional sleeveless jerseys eliminate sleeve interference during shooting, passing, and defensive movements, making them the preferred choice for serious players who need unrestricted range of motion during fast-paced Florida basketball action. The sleeveless design isn’t just about tradition – it provides practical cooling benefits in Florida’s warm climate while allowing complete customization with team names, player numbers, and logos that create the distinctive team identity coaches want to see on the court, all backed by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting your team straightforward and affordable.

Why do basketball players prefer sleeveless jerseys?

Sleeveless jerseys provide unrestricted arm movement for shooting, passing, and defensive actions, while offering superior ventilation that’s especially beneficial in Florida’s warm climate.

How do sleeveless jerseys improve performance during games?

By eliminating sleeve interference, players get better range of motion for shooting form and defensive movements, while enhanced cooling helps maintain energy during intense games.

Are sleeveless jerseys suitable for all basketball positions?

Yes, sleeveless jerseys work excellently for all positions, from guards who need shooting freedom to forwards and centers who benefit from unrestricted movement during post play.

What customization options work best on sleeveless jerseys?

Sleeveless jerseys offer excellent space for team names across the chest, player numbers front and back, and logo placement that takes advantage of the classic basketball aesthetic.

How do sleeveless jerseys handle Florida’s hot and humid conditions?

Sleeveless design provides maximum ventilation and cooling, making them ideal for Florida basketball where temperature management directly impacts player performance and comfort.

Do sleeveless jerseys meet league requirements across Florida?

Sleeveless jerseys are the traditional basketball uniform style and meet requirements for most leagues, though competitive leagues may have specific regulations to verify.

What’s the difference between sleeveless and tank top basketball jerseys?

Sleeveless basketball jerseys use traditional basketball construction and fit, while tank tops may have different necklines and cuts designed more for casual or training use.

Can sleeveless jerseys include sponsor logos effectively?

Yes, sleeveless jerseys provide excellent visibility for sponsor logos on the front chest area, helping Florida teams secure funding while maintaining professional appearance.

How do sleeveless jerseys work for youth teams in Florida?

Youth players love the traditional basketball look of sleeveless jerseys, and the enhanced cooling and movement benefits help young players develop proper form and stay comfortable.

What decoration methods work best for sleeveless basketball jerseys?

Heat transfer and screen printing both work excellently on sleeveless jerseys, with decoration placement optimized for the traditional basketball jersey areas.

Are sleeveless jerseys more cost-effective than other styles?

Sleeveless jerseys often cost slightly less due to reduced material usage, making them an economical choice for Florida teams wanting traditional basketball appearance.

How do sleeveless jerseys fit compared to regular shirts?

Sleeveless basketball jerseys use athletic cuts designed for basketball movement, typically fitting looser than regular shirts to allow for game action and air circulation.

Can sleeveless jerseys be worn for practice and games?

Absolutely – sleeveless jerseys work perfectly for both practice and games, giving Florida teams consistent appearance and performance benefits across all activities.

What colors work best for sleeveless basketball jerseys?

Traditional basketball colors like white, black, red, navy, and royal blue work excellently, creating classic looks that represent your Florida team professionally.

How do you ensure proper fit for sleeveless basketball jerseys?

We provide detailed sizing charts specific to sleeveless cuts, and our team can help Florida coaches determine the right fit for different player preferences and body types.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

What Your Jersey Is Made Of

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

What are the advantages of sleeveless basketball tank tops?

Sleeveless tank tops provide complete arm movement freedom, maximum cooling, and the classic basketball aesthetic that many Florida players prefer for training and competition.

How do sleeveless tank tops improve basketball performance?

By eliminating all sleeve interference, tank tops allow perfect shooting form, unrestricted defensive movements, and superior ventilation during intense Florida basketball action.

Are sleeveless tank tops suitable for competitive basketball?

Yes, sleeveless tank tops meet basketball requirements and provide professional appearance while offering the performance benefits that serious competitors appreciate.

Can sleeveless tank tops be customized with team branding?

Absolutely – tank tops offer excellent space for team names, logos, numbers, and graphics across the chest and back areas for comprehensive team identification.

How do sleeveless tank tops handle Florida’s hot climate?

Tank tops provide maximum ventilation and cooling, making them ideal for Florida’s warm weather basketball where temperature management directly impacts performance.

What’s the difference between tank tops and regular sleeveless jerseys?

Tank tops typically have wider armholes and more casual styling, while sleeveless jerseys may have more structured basketball-specific construction.

Can sleeveless tank tops work for both training and games?

Yes, tank tops provide versatility for training, practice, pickup games, and casual competition while maintaining team coordination and professional appearance.

How do sleeveless tank tops appeal to different player preferences?

Tank tops appeal to players who want maximum freedom, cooling benefits, and the classic basketball look that connects to the sport’s traditional aesthetics.

Are sleeveless tank tops suitable for youth basketball players?

Yes, youth players often prefer the freedom and cooling of tank tops, and they help young athletes develop proper shooting form without sleeve restrictions.

Can sleeveless tank tops be layered with other basketball apparel?

Tank tops work excellently as base layers under warm-ups or other team apparel, providing cooling while maintaining team coordination.

What decoration methods work best for sleeveless tank tops?

Screen printing, heat transfer, and embroidery all work well on tank tops, with decoration placement optimized for the sleeveless design and maximum visibility.

How do sleeveless tank tops help with shooting form development?

The complete absence of sleeves eliminates any potential interference with shooting motion, helping players develop consistent, unrestricted shooting form.

Can sleeveless tank tops coordinate with team shorts and other apparel?

Yes, tank tops can coordinate with shorts, warm-ups, and other team gear using consistent colors and branding for complete team identity.

What colors and designs work best for basketball tank tops?

All team colors work well, with bold graphics and clear team identification taking advantage of the generous decoration space that tank tops provide.

How do sleeveless tank tops contribute to player comfort during basketball?

Tank tops maximize comfort through unrestricted movement and superior cooling, helping Florida players stay focused on performance rather than discomfort from restrictive clothing.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Coaches and athletic directors trust us because we understand the pressure of getting jerseys ready before the first game — and we always confirm delivery timelines before you commit.

When a Sublimated Jersey Might Not Be the Right Choice
We'll always point you in the right direction

Sublimated jerseys are the best choice for most situations — but there are a few scenarios where a different product might serve you better. We would rather point you to the right product than have you order something that does not suit your needs.

If you need jerseys for daily practice sessions only and budget is the primary concern, our plain practice jerseys or blank mesh jerseys offer a more economical option. If your team needs to flip between home and away colors for every game, a reversible jersey gives you two designs in one garment.

What makes sublimated basketball jerseys special?

Sublimation embeds graphics directly into the polyester fibers, creating permanent designs that never crack, peel, or fade while allowing unlimited colors and complex graphics impossible with traditional methods.

Can you create any design with sublimated basketball jerseys?

Yes, sublimation allows unlimited colors, gradients, photographs, complex patterns, and artistic elements, giving Florida teams complete creative freedom for their unique identity.

How durable are sublimated graphics on basketball jerseys?

Sublimated graphics are permanently part of the fabric and cannot crack, peel, or wear off, maintaining vibrant appearance through multiple Florida basketball seasons and countless wash cycles.

What design elements work best with basketball jersey sublimation?

Sublimation excels at gradient backgrounds, team photographs, complex logos, artistic elements, all-over patterns, and multi-color designs that create stunning visual impact.

How long does it take to produce sublimated basketball jerseys?

Sublimated jerseys require 14-18 business days due to custom design development, detailed proofing process, and specialized production methods that ensure perfect results.

Can you match specific team colors with sublimation?

Sublimation can reproduce virtually any color with precision, including exact color matching to existing team equipment, school colors, or specific brand requirements.

Are sublimated jerseys more expensive than traditional jerseys?

Sublimated jerseys cost more initially due to the sophisticated process, but provide exceptional value through superior durability and unlimited design possibilities.

Can sublimated jerseys include sponsor logos and complex branding?

Yes, sublimation is ideal for incorporating sponsor logos, complex branding elements, and detailed graphics seamlessly into the overall jersey design.

Do sublimated jerseys perform as well as regular basketball jerseys?

Absolutely – sublimated jerseys use the same performance polyester materials with moisture-wicking and breathability, providing identical athletic performance benefits.

Can you create different home and away sublimated designs?

Yes, sublimation makes it cost-effective to create completely different home and away designs while maintaining consistent Florida team branding elements.

How do sublimated jerseys handle Florida’s intense basketball conditions?

Sublimated jerseys use performance materials designed for Florida’s climate, with the embedded graphics remaining perfect regardless of heat, humidity, or intensive play.

What’s the design process for custom sublimated basketball jerseys?

Our design team works with your concepts, creates detailed digital mockups, provides unlimited revisions, and ensures your Florida team gets exactly the look you envision.

Can sublimated jerseys include player photographs or team images?

Yes, sublimation can incorporate high-quality photographs, team pictures, or photographic elements as part of the overall jersey design with excellent results.

How do you care for sublimated basketball jerseys?

Sublimated jerseys require standard athletic care – machine wash cold, air dry when possible – and the permanent graphics will maintain their appearance indefinitely.

What makes Florida teams choose sublimated over traditional jerseys?

Florida teams choose sublimation for unlimited creative possibilities, permanent durability, vibrant colors, and the ability to create truly unique identities that stand out in competitive basketball.

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

These training shirts focus on the unique demands of basketball skill work and physical preparation, featuring advanced moisture-wicking technology that handles intense conditioning sessions, flexible construction that accommodates repetitive drilling movements, and durability designed to withstand the aggressive training schedules common in Florida’s competitive basketball development programs. What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Absolutely – training shorts are designed for extended wear during long conditioning sessions, skill camps, and intensive development programs common in Florida basketball.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

White shirts offer timeless athletic styling that projects professionalism and tradition, creating a crisp, fresh team appearance that represents purity of effort and team unity while providing the moisture-wicking performance and durability needed for serious basketball competition. The white color choice provides excellent visibility for team graphics and serves as the perfect canvas for bold team colors and designs, while also offering practical cooling benefits in Florida’s warm climate by reflecting heat rather than absorbing it like darker colors. These shirts work perfectly for teams that want to project clean, professional identity through their uniform choices while benefiting from the psychological impact of fresh, coordinated team appearance, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

What makes white basketball shirts ideal for Florida teams?

White shirts provide heat reflection benefits perfect for Florida’s warm climate while offering classic, professional appearance and excellent visibility for team graphics.

Do white basketball shirts show dirt and stains easily?

Modern white shirts use stain-resistant treatments and materials designed for easy care, though they may require more frequent washing to maintain pristine appearance.

What decoration colors work best with white basketball shirts?

All colors work exceptionally well on white, with dark colors like navy, black, and red creating bold contrast, while bright colors create vibrant, eye-catching designs.

How do white shirts perform in hot Florida basketball conditions?

White shirts reflect heat rather than absorbing it, providing cooling advantages during outdoor play and sunny conditions compared to darker colors.

Are white basketball shirts suitable for competitive play?

Yes, white shirts provide professional appearance meeting all competitive requirements while offering practical and psychological benefits for serious basketball.

Can white shirts coordinate effectively with team colors?

White serves as an excellent base for any team color scheme, allowing bold accent colors and complex designs while maintaining clean, professional appearance.

How do white basketball shirts photograph and appear on media?

White shirts provide excellent contrast for photography and video coverage, making team graphics and player movements highly visible for media presentation.

What care is required to maintain white shirt brightness?

Machine wash with quality detergents, use bleach alternatives when needed, air dry in sunlight when possible, and store properly to maintain bright white appearance.

Can white shirts include multiple colors in the same design?

Yes, white backgrounds allow unlimited color combinations and complex graphics while maintaining readability and professional appearance.

Do white basketball shirts work for both indoor and outdoor play?

White shirts excel for both environments, providing cooling benefits outdoors and clean, professional appearance for indoor competition and practice.

How do white shirts contribute to team psychology and confidence?

White often represents purity, fresh starts, and unity, helping teams project clean, professional image while building confidence through coordinated appearance.

Can white shirts be enhanced with special effects or treatments?

Yes, white shirts work well with metallic accents, holographic elements, or special finishes while maintaining the clean white base appearance.

What’s the visibility advantage of white for sponsor recognition?

White backgrounds provide maximum visibility for sponsor logos in any color, making them highly effective for marketing and partnership recognition.

How do white basketball shirts work in different lighting conditions?

White shirts maintain excellent visibility in all lighting conditions, from bright outdoor sunlight to indoor gymnasium lighting, ensuring consistent team appearance.

Can white shirts be part of traditional basketball uniform programs?

White shirts represent classic basketball tradition and work excellently as home uniforms or as versatile pieces in comprehensive uniform programs.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

What Your Jersey Is Made Of

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

Sublimation Polyester
100% Polyester 150–160 GSM Florida-Ready

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Our athletic mesh fabric features an open-weave construction that maximises air circulation across the body — making it the go-to choice for Florida programs playing in hot gymnasiums or outdoor courts. Our moisture-wicking performance fabric uses a polyester-spandex blend with capillary wicking channels built into the weave. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Send us heights and weights

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Send us your roster list with heights and weights and we'll size every player for you — free, as part of your quote.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.
