How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Youth Basketball Jerseys

Youth basketball jerseys from Florida Basketball Jerseys specifically designed for young players across Florida who need uniforms that accommodate growing bodies, active play styles, and the unique requirements of youth basketball while providing the same professional appearance and performance features that help build confidence and team pride. These youth jerseys use materials and construction methods adapted for younger players, including reinforced stitching in high-wear areas, comfortable fits that allow for growth spurts, and decoration that withstands the aggressive washing cycles that come with muddy practices and grass-stained games. The youth-specific design approach recognizes that young players need uniforms that perform during intense youth league action while appealing to parents who want durable, easy-care options, all supported by our commitment to no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping that makes outfitting youth teams both affordable and straightforward.

What makes youth basketball jerseys different from adult jerseys?

Youth jerseys use age-appropriate sizing, kid-safe materials, reinforced construction for active play, and decoration designed to withstand frequent washing after energetic youth games.

What age range are youth basketball jerseys designed for?

Youth jerseys typically fit players ages 6-14, with sizing from Youth XS to Youth XL designed to accommodate growth spurts and different development stages.

How do youth jerseys accommodate growing players?

Youth jerseys include growth allowance in sizing, comfortable fits that don’t restrict movement, and construction that maintains appearance even as players grow.

Are youth jerseys safe for children with sensitive skin?

Yes, youth jerseys use kid-safe materials and decoration methods that meet safety standards for children’s apparel, with soft-touch graphics and hypoallergenic treatments.

Can youth jerseys handle the washing demands of active kids?

Absolutely – youth jerseys are designed for frequent washing, with stain-resistant treatments and construction tested for heavy wash cycles that come with youth sports.

How do youth jerseys help build team confidence in young players?

Professional-looking youth jerseys help kids feel like real basketball players, building confidence and team pride that translates into better performance and enjoyment.

Can youth teams mix different sizes effectively?

Yes, youth teams often need multiple sizes to accommodate players of different ages and development stages, and we coordinate colors and designs across all sizes.

What customization options appeal to young basketball players?

Youth players love team names, player numbers, fun team slogans, and sometimes player nicknames using kid-friendly fonts and graphics.

How do parents typically handle youth jersey ordering?

Many parents coordinate through team managers or coaches, and our no minimum order policy makes it easy for individual families to order additional jerseys or replacements.

Do youth jerseys provide the same performance benefits as adult jerseys?

Yes, youth jerseys use performance materials adapted for young athletes, providing moisture-wicking and comfort benefits that help kids play their best.

Can youth jerseys be used for multiple sports or just basketball?

While designed for basketball, youth jerseys work well for other activities and sports, giving families versatile athletic wear for active Florida kids.

How do you determine the right size for growing youth players?

We provide youth-specific sizing charts and can help Florida parents choose sizes that accommodate current fit plus reasonable growth throughout the season.

What colors and designs work best for youth basketball teams?

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Youth Basketball Uniforms

Youth basketball uniforms from Florida Basketball Jerseys designed specifically for young players across Florida who need complete uniform sets that accommodate growing bodies, active play styles, and the unique requirements of youth basketball while providing professional appearance that builds confidence and team pride. These youth uniforms include both jerseys and shorts with age-appropriate sizing, kid-safe materials, and construction methods that handle the demanding use patterns of enthusiastic young athletes who play hard and require frequent washing after energetic games and practices. The youth-specific design approach recognizes that young players need uniforms that work for parents managing laundry loads and budgets while creating the professional team appearance that helps kids feel like real basketball players, complete with customization options for team names, player numbers, and logos that build team identity during the crucial developmental years, all supported by our parent-friendly approach including no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

What’s included in a complete youth basketball uniform?

Youth uniforms include coordinated jerseys and shorts designed specifically for young players with age-appropriate sizing, kid-safe materials, and professional team appearance.

How do youth uniforms accommodate growing players?

Youth uniforms include growth allowance in sizing, comfortable fits that don’t restrict movement, and construction that maintains appearance as young players grow throughout the season.

Are youth uniforms safe for children with sensitive skin?

Yes, youth uniforms use kid-safe materials and decoration methods that meet safety standards for children’s apparel, with hypoallergenic options and soft-touch graphics.

Can youth uniforms handle frequent washing from active kids?

Absolutely – youth uniforms are designed for heavy wash cycles with stain-resistant treatments and construction tested for frequent laundering after energetic games.

How do youth uniforms help build team confidence?

Professional-quality uniforms help young players feel like real basketball players, building confidence and team pride that contributes to positive sports experiences.

What customization options appeal to young basketball players?

Youth players love team names, player numbers, fun team slogans, and colorful graphics using kid-friendly fonts that create excitement about their team.

How do parents typically coordinate youth uniform orders?

Many parents work through team coordinators or coaches, and our no minimum policy makes it easy for families to order additional uniforms or handle size changes.

Can youth uniforms be used for multiple sports activities?

While designed for basketball, youth uniforms work well for other sports and activities, giving Florida families versatile athletic wear for active kids.

What colors and designs work best for youth basketball uniforms?

Bright, vibrant colors and fun design elements appeal to youth players while maintaining the professional coordination that coaches and parents appreciate.

How do youth uniforms help parents manage sports expenses?

Youth uniforms provide complete team outfitting at budget-friendly prices, allowing professional appearance while managing the cost pressures common in youth sports.

What’s the typical sizing approach for youth basketball teams?

Youth teams often need multiple sizes to accommodate players of different ages and development stages, with sizing from Youth XS to Youth XL covering most needs.

Can youth uniforms include educational or motivational elements?

Yes, youth uniforms can include positive messages, team values, or skill development reminders that support the educational aspects of youth basketball.

How do youth uniforms contribute to positive sports experiences?

Professional uniforms create positive memories, build team identity, and give young Florida athletes pride in their team participation and athletic development.

What’s the durability expectation for youth basketball uniforms?

Youth uniforms are designed for season-long use with construction that handles the demanding play patterns and frequent washing requirements of youth sports.

How do youth uniforms support team building among young players?

Matching uniforms create team unity and identity that helps young Florida players develop teamwork skills, basketball friendships, and lasting sports memories.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Youth Practice Basketball Jerseys

These youth practice jerseys combine age-appropriate sizing and construction with materials that withstand frequent washing after muddy outdoor practices and energetic training activities, while providing the moisture-wicking performance that helps young Florida athletes stay comfortable during skill development work. The youth-focused design recognizes that young players need practice uniforms that accommodate growth spurts, aggressive play, and the general wear-and-tear that comes with enthusiastic youth basketball participation, while also providing the professional appearance that builds confidence and team pride during the crucial developmental years when players are learning to love the game, all supported by our parent-friendly approach including no minimum orders, free design services, and free Florida shipping.

What makes youth practice jerseys different from adult practice jerseys?

Youth practice jerseys use age-appropriate sizing, kid-safe materials, reinforced construction for active play, and decoration designed for frequent washing after energetic practices.

How do youth practice jerseys accommodate growing players?

Youth jerseys include growth allowance in sizing, comfortable fits that don’t restrict movement, and construction that maintains appearance as young players grow.

Are youth practice jerseys safe for children with sensitive skin?

Yes, youth practice jerseys use kid-safe materials and decoration methods that meet safety standards for children’s apparel, with hypoallergenic options available.

Can youth practice jerseys handle frequent washing from active kids?

Absolutely – youth practice jerseys are designed for heavy wash cycles with stain-resistant treatments and construction tested for frequent laundering.

How do youth practice jerseys help with team organization?

Youth practice jerseys can include numbers, names, or position designations that help coaches organize drills and activities during youth basketball training.

What customization options appeal to young basketball players?

Youth players love team names, player numbers, fun team slogans, and motivational graphics using kid-friendly fonts and designs.

How do parents typically coordinate youth practice jersey orders?

Many parents work through team coordinators or coaches, and our no minimum policy makes it easy for families to order additional jerseys or replacements.

Can youth practice jerseys be used for multiple activities?

While designed for basketball practice, youth jerseys work well for other sports and activities, giving Florida families versatile athletic wear for active kids.

How do youth practice jerseys support positive sports experiences?

Professional-quality jerseys help young players feel like real athletes, building confidence and enjoyment that contributes to positive youth sports participation.

What colors and designs work best for youth practice jerseys?

Bright, vibrant colors and fun design elements appeal to youth players while maintaining the team coordination that coaches and parents appreciate.

How do youth practice jerseys compare in durability to game jerseys?

Youth practice jerseys focus on durability over premium appearance, designed to withstand the demanding use patterns of active young players.

Can youth practice jerseys include educational or motivational elements?

Yes, youth practice jerseys can include positive messages, team values, or skill development reminders that support the educational aspects of youth sports.

How do youth practice jerseys help parents manage sports expenses?

Practice jerseys provide cost-effective solutions for youth teams, allowing professional appearance while managing the budget pressures common in youth sports.

What’s the typical replacement cycle for youth practice jerseys?

Youth practice jerseys are designed for season-long use, though growing players may need size adjustments during extended youth basketball seasons.

How do youth practice jerseys contribute to team building?

Matching practice jerseys create team unity and identity that helps young Florida players develop teamwork skills and basketball friendships.

What Is a
Sublimated
Basketball Jersey?

Full-Dye Custom Jerseys for Florida Teams

A sublimated basketball jersey is a fully custom, full-color jersey where the design is permanently fused into the fabric — not printed on top of it. Using a heat-transfer process called dye sublimation, your colors, logos, names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself, producing vivid, edge-to-edge artwork that will not crack, peel, or fade.

This makes sublimated jerseys the highest-quality, longest-lasting option for Florida basketball teams that want a professional look without a professional budget. Every jersey in your order is produced to exactly the same specification — consistent colors, consistent quality, across your entire roster.

Because the design starts from a blank canvas, there are no template restrictions. Your colors, your logo, your player names, your numbers — every element is built around your team's identity from scratch.

Fabric & Construction Details

Every sublimated basketball jersey we produce is made from high-performance athletic fabric selected specifically for Florida's heat and humidity. Here is exactly what goes into your jerseys — from the weave of the fabric to the finish of every seam.

Our standard sublimation polyester is a smooth-surface, tightly-woven 100% polyester fabric engineered for high-definition dye sublimation printing. The tight weave produces a clean, even surface that allows your design colors to appear vivid and precise — no bleeding, no blurring, no visible texture disrupting the artwork. At 150–160 GSM, it is lightweight enough for intense game play while carrying enough body to hold its shape across a full season of use.

Flatlock Stitching

All seams are finished with flatlock stitching — a technique that lays the seam flat against the fabric rather than bunching it. This eliminates chafing at underarm and side seams during intense play.

Reinforced Stress Points

High-stress areas — collar, armhole, and side seams — are reinforced with bar-tack stitching at key stress points, preventing seam separation during physical play and extended wear.

Hemmed Armholes

Armhole edges are clean-hemmed with a rolled finish to prevent fraying and maintain a professional appearance across the full lifespan of the jersey — season after season.

Pre-Shrunk Construction

All fabric is pre-shrunk before cutting and production, ensuring the jersey you receive maintains its shape and size after washing. The size you order is the size you get — even after repeated machine washes.

Care Instructions — Keep Your Jerseys Looking New
Machine wash cold Use cold water on a gentle or delicate cycle to preserve color vibrancy.
Wash inside out Turning the jersey inside out before washing protects the printed surface.
Hang to air dry Air drying preserves fabric shape and extends the life of the sublimation print.
No high-heat drying High heat in tumble dryers can warp the fabric and degrade the print over time.
No bleach or softeners Bleach and fabric softeners break down the polyester fibres and degrade color over time.
Do not iron the print Never iron directly on the printed surface — heat will damage the dye sublimation permanently.

Florida teams — outdoor and summer courts: For jerseys worn on outdoor courts in Florida's sun and heat, our UPF 30+ polyester fabric provides additional protection while the moisture-wicking surface keeps players cooler during long outdoor sessions. Air drying is especially effective in Florida's warm climate — jerseys dry in minutes.

How to Measure — Jersey
1
Chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape horizontal and under the armpits.
2
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline — the narrowest part of the torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button.
3
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the hips and seat, keeping the tape level all the way around.
4
Height: Measure from the top of the head to the floor in bare feet. Use a wall and a book for accuracy.
How to Measure — Shorts
1
Waist: Measure around the natural waistline where the shorts will sit — not the hips. Keep the tape snug but not tight.
2
Hip: Measure around the fullest part of the seat and hips. This is the widest measurement when standing straight.
3
Inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down to the desired hem length on the inner thigh. Standard basketball shorts fall mid-thigh.
4
When in doubt: Size up for shorts. A slightly looser fit is always more comfortable during physical play than a fit that is too snug.
When between sizes — size up

Basketball is an active sport. A jersey that is slightly larger allows full range of motion without restriction. If a player falls between two sizes, always select the larger size.

Youth sizes can overlap adult Small

Youth XL and adult Small are very close in measurement. For players aged 13–15, we recommend measuring carefully and comparing against both charts before deciding.

Not confident about sizing? Include your players' heights and weights in your quote request. Our team will recommend the right size for every player on your roster — at no charge.

Legal Document

Refund
Policy

Last updated: January 1, 2025
Effective: January 1, 2025
Florida Basketball Jerseys — Orlando, FL
Our Errors = Full Remedy
Production mistakes are our responsibility — always
Proof Approval is Final

No Returns on Custom Orders

Florida Basketball Jerseys — Refund Policy
Last updated: January 1, 2025
Effective: January 1, 2025

Because every product we make is custom-designed and produced specifically for your team, our refund policy differs from standard retail returns. Please read this policy carefully before placing an order. By submitting a quote request and approving a design proof, you agree to the terms outlined below.

1
Section 1

Our Core Commitment

We stand behind everything we produce. If we make a mistake — a production error, a defect in materials, or a jersey that does not match your approved proof — we will make it right at no cost to you. This is our fundamental promise to every customer.

We invest in a design proof approval process specifically to ensure that what you approve is exactly what gets produced. When both parties confirm the design in writing, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering that exact product.

Our promise: If we produce something that does not match your approved proof due to our error, we will reprint the affected jerseys or issue a full or partial refund — whichever resolves the issue most appropriately for you.

2
Section 2

What Is & Isn't Eligible for a Refund

The following scenarios outline when a refund, reprint, or remedy is — and is not — applicable:

Eligible
Production Error by Us

The delivered jerseys contain errors that differ from your approved design proof — wrong colors, wrong names, wrong numbers, wrong logo placement, or incorrect sizing compared to what was ordered and approved.

Eligible
Defective Materials or Manufacturing

Jerseys arrive with material defects, printing defects, stitching failures, or quality issues not caused by normal wear and use. This includes premature cracking, peeling, or fading that occurs before the item has been used.

Eligible
Lost or Significantly Damaged in Shipping

Your order is confirmed lost by the carrier or arrives with significant damage that occurred during transit and is documented with carrier evidence.

Not Eligible
Errors Present in the Approved Proof

If a misspelled name, wrong number, incorrect color, or any other error was present in the design proof you approved, the production is correct and a refund or reprint cannot be issued. Review all proofs carefully before approving.

Not Eligible
Change of Mind or Team Roster Changes

Refunds are not available because a player left the team, the season was cancelled, you changed your color preference after production began, or for any reason unrelated to a defect or production error.

Not Eligible
Sizing Issues Based on Customer-Provided Information

If you submitted sizing information in your order and the jerseys match those exact sizes, we cannot accept returns due to fit preferences or sizing choices made at the time of ordering. We provide size guidance upon request.

Not Eligible
Damage Caused by Washing, Wear, or Misuse

Damage caused by improper washing, machine drying at high heat, bleaching, or general misuse after delivery is not covered under our refund policy.

Case by Case
Partial Orders with Mixed Issues

If part of a bulk order has production issues and part does not, we will assess each affected item individually and offer a targeted remedy — reprint of affected items or partial credit — rather than a full order refund.

3
Section 3

How to Submit a Refund or Reprint Request

If you believe your order qualifies for a refund or reprint based on the criteria above, please follow these steps:

1
Contact Us Within 7 Days of Delivery

All claims must be submitted within 7 calendar days of confirmed delivery. Contact us at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com or call (407) 555-0192.

2
Provide Your Order Details

Include your order reference number, the name on the order, and the delivery date so we can locate your order quickly.

3
Send Clear Photos of the Issue

Attach clear photographs showing the defect or discrepancy. Photos should show the full jersey and a close-up of the specific issue. This allows us to assess the claim accurately and quickly.

4
We Review and Respond Within 3 Business Days

Our team will review your claim and photographic evidence against your approved proof. We will respond within 3 business days with our assessment and proposed remedy.

5
Remedy Is Applied

If your claim is approved, we will arrange either a reprint of the affected jerseys at no charge or issue a refund to your original payment method. Reprints are typically the preferred remedy as they get your team the jerseys they need.

Do not return items before contacting us. We will advise whether items need to be returned as part of the claims process. Unsolicited returns will not be accepted and may delay your claim.

4
Section 4

Refund Methods & Timelines

Where a refund is approved, we will process it using the following methods and timelines:

  • Original Payment Method: Refunds are issued to the original payment method used for the order.
  • Processing Time: Approved refunds are typically processed within 5–10 business days. The time for funds to appear in your account depends on your bank or payment provider and may take an additional 3–7 business days.
  • Partial Refunds: Where only part of an order is affected, a partial refund proportional to the affected items will be issued.
  • Store Credit Option: In some cases, we may offer store credit as an alternative to a cash refund, at your discretion. Store credit has no expiry date.
  • Reprint Option: In most cases involving production errors, a reprint is the fastest and most practical remedy. We will always offer this as an option.

Shipping costs on the original order are non-refundable in cases where only part of the order is affected. If the entire order is affected by a production error on our part, all associated costs including shipping are refundable.

5
Section 5

Order Cancellations

Orders may be cancelled or modified only under the following conditions:

  • Before proof approval: Orders may be cancelled at any time before you have approved a design proof. No charges will be applied at this stage.
  • After proof approval but before payment: If you have approved a proof but not yet paid, you may cancel without penalty. Your approved proof will be held on file for 30 days should you wish to proceed later.
  • After proof approval and payment: Once payment has been received and production has begun, orders cannot be cancelled or modified. Production of custom items begins immediately upon payment confirmation.
  • Mid-production changes: Changes to names, numbers, colors, or sizing cannot be made once production has started. Any changes at this stage would require a new order.

If you are unsure about any details of your order, do not approve your proof until you are fully satisfied. We encourage you to share the proof with your team, coaching staff, or players before giving final approval. There is no time limit on your proof review — take the time you need.

6
Section 6

Proof Approval Responsibility

The design proof approval stage is the most important step in the entire ordering process. When you approve a proof in writing, you are confirming that:

  • All player names are spelled correctly
  • All player numbers are correct
  • Colors match your team's requirements
  • Logo placement and sizing is correct
  • The overall design layout is as you expected
  • The size run (quantities per size) is accurate

We recommend reviewing the proof against your original roster list and checking each player's details individually before approving. We offer unlimited revisions before approval — use them.

7
Section 7

Shipping-Related Issues

Once your order has been dispatched and tracking information has been provided, responsibility for delivery passes to the shipping carrier. However, we will always assist you in resolving any shipping issues.

  • Lost Orders: If your order is confirmed lost by the carrier, we will work with the carrier to file a claim and arrange a reprint or refund once the investigation is complete.
  • Damaged in Transit: If your order arrives damaged due to shipping, document the damage with photos and contact us within 7 days of delivery. We will work with you to resolve the issue.
  • Incorrect Address: If an order is undeliverable or returned due to an incorrect address provided by you, re-shipping costs will be your responsibility. Please double-check your delivery address before order confirmation.
  • Delivery Delays: We are not responsible for carrier delays. If a deadline is critical to your order, please communicate this clearly at the time of quoting so we can plan accordingly.
8
Section 8

Contact Us About Your Order

If you have any issue with your order, or any question about this refund policy, please reach out to us directly. We handle every claim personally and our goal is always to find a fair resolution quickly.

  • Email: info@floridabasketballjerseys.com — best for claims requiring photo documentation
  • Phone: (407) 555-0192 — Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–3pm EST
  • Address: 4820 S. Orange Ave, Suite 110, Orlando, FL 32806
  • Response time: We respond to all refund and claims enquiries within 3 business days.
Issue With Your Order?

Email us at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com with photos of the issue and your order details. We respond within 3 business days.

<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .fbj-sp-wrap {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  /* ==============================
     HERO
  ============================== */
  .fbj-sp-hero {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 64px 24px 72px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .fbj-sp-breadcrumb {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-sp-breadcrumb a {
    color: #4A6A84;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-sp-breadcrumb a:hover { color: #FF8C2A; }
  .fbj-sp-breadcrumb-sep { color: #2E4A60; }
  .fbj-sp-breadcrumb-current { color: #A3B5CC; font-weight: 500; }

  .fbj-sp-hero-tag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.25);
    border-radius: 100px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-h1 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 0.95;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-h1 span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-sp-hero-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: #4A6A84;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-meta-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-hero-meta-item svg { color: #F4700A; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ==============================
     KEY FACTS STRIP
  ============================== */
  .fbj-sp-facts-strip {
    background: #112444;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    padding: 0 24px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-facts-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-sp-fact-item {
    flex: 1 1 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 22px 18px;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-sp-fact-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .fbj-sp-fact-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }

  .fbj-sp-fact-icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-fact-val {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #F4700A;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-fact-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #5A7A96;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* ==============================
     MAIN LAYOUT
  ============================== */
  .fbj-sp-main {
    padding: 64px 24px 80px;
    background: #F5F7FA;
  }

  .fbj-sp-main-inner {
    max-width: 1140px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 260px;
    gap: 52px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  /* ==============================
     DOCUMENT
  ============================== */
  .fbj-sp-doc {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(11,31,58,0.05);
  }

  .fbj-sp-doc-head {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    padding: 28px 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .fbj-sp-doc-head-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  .fbj-sp-doc-head-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #4A6A84;
    line-height: 1.5;
    text-align: right;
  }

  .fbj-sp-doc-body { padding: 44px 40px; }

  /* Intro box */
  .fbj-sp-intro-box {
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.18);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-intro-box p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-sp-intro-box p strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Free shipping hero card */
  .fbj-sp-free-card {
    background: #0B1F3A;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 32px 28px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: rgba(244,112,10,0.15);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(244,112,10,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #FF8C2A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-text {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-tag {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-title {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 1.0;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-title span { color: #F4700A; }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-body {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: #6A8499;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .fbj-sp-free-card-body strong { color: #A3B5CC; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Section */
  .fbj-sp-section {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
  }

  .fbj-sp-section:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-section-num {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-section-num-badge {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: #F4700A;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-section-num-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
  }

  .fbj-sp-section-h2 {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0B1F3A;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .fbj-sp-prose {
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.85;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-sp-prose p { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .fbj-sp-prose p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .fbj-sp-prose strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  .fbj-sp-prose a {
    color: #F4700A;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-sp-prose a:hover {
    color: #D95F05;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  /* List */
  .fbj-sp-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 12px 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: #4A6070;
  }

  .fbj-sp-list li::before {
    content: '';
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #F4700A;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 7px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-list li strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Shipping table */
  .fbj-sp-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: 16px 0;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-sp-table thead tr { background: #0B1F3A; }

  .fbj-sp-table thead th {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #A3B5CC;
    text-align: left;
    border: none;
  }

  .fbj-sp-table tbody tr {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-sp-table tbody tr:hover { background: #F8FAFC; }
  .fbj-sp-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .fbj-sp-table tbody td {
    padding: 13px 16px;
    color: #4A6070;
    vertical-align: top;
    line-height: 1.55;
    border: none;
  }

  .fbj-sp-table tbody td:first-child {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #0B1F3A;
  }

  .fbj-sp-table-free {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    background: rgba(30,125,58,0.1);
    color: #1E7D3A;
    border: 1px solid rgba(30,125,58,0.2);
    border-radius: 100px;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Highlight box */
  .fbj-sp-highlight {
    background: #F0F4FA;
    border-left: 3px solid #F4700A;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-highlight p {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: #3A5068;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-highlight p strong { color: #0B1F3A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Info box */
  .fbj-sp-info-box {
    background: rgba(26,94,190,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(26,94,190,0.15);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .fbj-sp-info-icon { color: #1A5EBE; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }

  .fbj-sp-info-box p {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: #3A5A7A;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-info-box p strong { color: #1A5EBE; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Warning box */
  .fbj-sp-warning {
    background: rgba(192,32,42,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(192,32,42,0.15);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .fbj-sp-warning-icon { color: #C0202A; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }

  .fbj-sp-warning p {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: #6A3A3A;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .fbj-sp-warning p strong { color: #C0202A; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Timeline visual */
  .fbj-sp-timeline {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin: 20px 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #E2E8F0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .fbj-sp-tl-step {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 18px 14px;
    text-align: center;
    border-right: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
    position: relative;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .fbj-sp-tl-step:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .fbj-sp-tl-step:hover { background: #F8FAFC; }

  .fbj-sp-tl-step::after {
    content: '›';
    position: absolute;
    right: -8px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    color: #F4700A;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .fbj-sp-tl-step:last-child::after { display: none; }

  .fbj-sp-tl-num {
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #F4700A;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .fbj-sp-tl-title {
    font-size: 13px;

                    <td>Contact us to confirm</td>
                    <td>Rush fee may apply — availability not guaranteed</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>

              <div class="fbj-sp-highlight">
                <p><strong>All production timelines begin after:</strong> (1) your design proof has been approved in writing, and (2) full payment has been received. The clock does not start on the day you submit your quote — it starts on the day both conditions are met.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Section 4 -->
          <div class="fbj-sp-section" id="sp-4">

              <div class="fbj-sp-section-num-badge" aria-hidden="true">4</div>
              <span class="fbj-sp-section-num-label">Section 4</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="fbj-sp-section-h2">Season Deadlines & Rush Orders</h2>
            <div class="fbj-sp-prose">
              <p>We understand that basketball seasons operate on fixed schedules. If you have a hard deadline — a first game date, a tournament start, or a season opener — please communicate this <strong>at the time of your quote request</strong>, not after.</p>
              <ul class="fbj-sp-list">
                <li><strong>Tell us your deadline upfront:</strong> Include your required delivery date in your quote request message. We will confirm whether the timeline is achievable before you commit to the order.</li>
                <li><strong>We will not take an order we cannot fulfil on time:</strong> If we cannot meet your deadline with our standard production schedule, we will tell you immediately so you have time to make alternative arrangements.</li>
                <li><strong>Rush production:</strong> In some cases, rush production is available at an additional cost. Rush availability depends on our current production schedule and cannot be guaranteed. Contact us as early as possible if you need an expedited order.</li>
                <li><strong>Delays outside our control:</strong> Carrier delays, weather events, and other factors outside our control may affect delivery even with a confirmed timeline. We will always communicate proactively if we anticipate any delay to your order.</li>
              </ul>
              <div class="fbj-sp-warning">
                <div class="fbj-sp-warning-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none"><path d="M9 2L1.5 15.5h15L9 2z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M9 7v4M9 12.5v1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
                </div>
                <p><strong>Important:</strong> We are not liable for losses, costs, or damages resulting from production or shipping delays, including missed games, tournaments, or season deadlines. Always build in buffer time when placing your order — we recommend ordering at least 4 weeks before your first game date.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Section 5 -->
          <div class="fbj-sp-section" id="sp-5">
            <div class="fbj-sp-section-num">
              <div class="fbj-sp-section-num-badge" aria-hidden="true">5</div>
              <span class="fbj-sp-section-num-label">Section 5</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="fbj-sp-section-h2">Order Dispatch & Tracking</h2>
            <div class="fbj-sp-prose">
              <p>Once your order has been produced, quality-checked, packed, and handed to our shipping carrier, we will send you a dispatch confirmation by email containing:</p>
              <ul class="fbj-sp-list">
                <li><strong>Dispatch notification email</strong> confirming your order has shipped</li>
                <li><strong>Carrier name</strong> (UPS, FedEx, or USPS depending on order size and destination)</li>
                <li><strong>Tracking number</strong> — clickable link to track your package in real time</li>
                <li><strong>Estimated delivery date</strong> based on carrier schedule at time of dispatch</li>
              </ul>
              <div class="fbj-sp-highlight">
                <p><strong>Bulk orders:</strong> Large orders going to a single address will typically ship as one or more packages within the same dispatch. If your order ships in multiple boxes, you will receive a tracking number for each package.</p>
              </div>
              <p>Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to update in the carrier's system after dispatch. If your tracking number is not showing movement 48 hours after dispatch, please contact us and we will investigate with the carrier.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Section 6 -->
          <div class="fbj-sp-section" id="sp-6">
            <div class="fbj-sp-section-num">
              <div class="fbj-sp-section-num-badge" aria-hidden="true">6</div>
              <span class="fbj-sp-section-num-label">Section 6</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="fbj-sp-section-h2">Delivery Address & Accuracy</h2>
            <div class="fbj-sp-prose">
              <p>It is your responsibility to provide a complete, accurate, and deliverable shipping address when you place your order. Please double-check your delivery details before confirming your order, including:</p>
              <ul class="fbj-sp-list">
                <li>Full street address including unit, suite, or apartment number where applicable</li>
                <li>Correct city, state, and ZIP code</li>
                <li>A recipient name that corresponds to the delivery location</li>
                <li>A contact phone number in case the carrier needs to reach you for delivery</li>
              </ul>
              <p>If an order is returned to us due to an incorrect address, refused delivery, or inability to deliver, we will contact you to arrange re-shipment. <strong>Re-shipping costs for returned parcels due to customer address error will be the customer's responsibility.</strong></p>
              <div class="fbj-sp-info-box">
                <div class="fbj-sp-info-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none"><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/><path d="M9 8v5M9 6v.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
                </div>
                <p><strong>School and program orders:</strong> If shipping to a school or organization, include the school name, the attention of a specific person (e.g., "Attn: Coach Johnson"), and the specific building or room if applicable. This helps ensure smooth delivery to large campuses.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

              <span class="fbj-sp-section-num-label">Section 7</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="fbj-sp-section-h2">Lost, Damaged, or Missing Orders</h2>

              <p>We take full care in packing and inspecting every order before dispatch. In the rare event of a shipping issue, here is how we handle it:</p>
              <ul class="fbj-sp-list">
                <li><strong>Order confirmed lost by carrier:</strong> If the carrier confirms your order is lost in transit, we will work with them to file a claim and arrange a reprint or refund. Please allow 5–10 business days for the carrier's investigation process.</li>
                <li><strong>Order damaged in transit:</strong> If your order arrives damaged, photograph the damage (both packaging and jerseys) and contact us within 7 days of delivery. We will assess the claim and arrange a resolution — typically a reprint or replacement of damaged items.</li>
                <li><strong>Partial delivery:</strong> If only part of your order arrives (e.g., one box of a multi-box shipment), contact us immediately so we can investigate with the carrier and arrange delivery of the missing items.</li>
                <li><strong>Delivery marked as complete but not received:</strong> If tracking shows delivery but you have not received the order, check with neighbours, building management, or other household members first. If still not located, contact us within 7 days of the marked delivery date and we will initiate a carrier investigation.</li>
              </ul>
              <p>See our <a href="/refund-policy">Refund Policy</a> for full details on how shipping-related issues are resolved.</p>

Florida Basketball Jerseys — Terms of Service
Last updated: January 1, 2025
Effective: January 1, 2025

Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the website located at floridabasketballjerseys.com or placing any order with Florida Basketball Jerseys. By accessing our website, submitting a quote request, or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website or services.

1
Section 1

About Us & Acceptance of Terms

Florida Basketball Jerseys ("Company," "we," "our," or "us") is a custom basketball jersey and uniform supplier based in Orlando, Florida, operating through floridabasketballjerseys.com. We supply custom basketball jerseys, uniforms, shorts, and related apparel primarily to sports teams, schools, leagues, clubs, and individuals across Florida and the United States.

By visiting our website, submitting a quote request, placing an order, or engaging with our design or production services in any way, you ("Customer," "you," or "your") agree to these Terms of Service in full. These terms apply to all visitors, customers, and users of our website and services.

We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon posting to the website. Continued use of our website or services after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

2
Section 2

Ordering Process & Quote Requests

Our ordering process begins with a quote request. Submitting a quote request does not constitute a binding order or financial commitment. An order is only confirmed when:

  • You have received and reviewed your free design proof
  • You have provided written approval of the design proof
  • Payment has been received in full or a deposit has been agreed upon in writing

We reserve the right to decline any order at our sole discretion, including orders that contain content we deem inappropriate, infringing, or that we are unable to produce to our quality standards.

Design Proof Approval: Once you approve a design proof in writing (via email or our quote system), you accept full responsibility for the accuracy of all content in that proof — including names, numbers, colors, logos, and sizing. Production begins immediately upon written approval and payment.

It is your responsibility to review all proofs carefully before approval. We will not be held liable for errors in names, numbers, colors, sizing, or design elements that were included in an approved proof.

3
Section 3

Pricing, Payment & Invoicing

All prices quoted are in US Dollars (USD) and are valid for the period stated in the quote. Quotes are subject to change if order specifications change after the quote is issued.

  • Design fees: Our design service is provided at no charge on all orders.
  • Shipping: Standard shipping to all US addresses is provided free of charge on all orders.
  • Payment timing: Full payment is required before production begins, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  • Accepted payment methods: We accept payment via methods stated on our invoice. We do not accept cash or personal checks unless agreed in advance.
  • Currency: All transactions are processed in US Dollars.

Prices are subject to change without notice. However, once a written quote has been issued and accepted, the price will be honored for the quoted order as long as the specifications do not change.

Taxes: Applicable sales tax may be added to orders shipped to certain states in accordance with applicable state tax laws. Florida sales tax may apply to orders delivered within the state of Florida.

4
Section 4

Custom & Personalized Orders

All products supplied by Florida Basketball Jerseys are custom-made to order and personalized to your specifications. As a result:

  • No returns or exchanges are accepted on custom or personalized items unless the error is a result of our production mistake (see our Refund Policy).
  • Once production has begun following your written proof approval and payment, orders cannot be cancelled or modified.
  • You are solely responsible for ensuring all submitted information (names, numbers, colors, sizing, logos) is accurate before approving the proof.
  • Sizing decisions are your responsibility. We provide size guidance upon request, but we are not liable for sizing errors based on information you provide.

Important: Custom orders cannot be returned or exchanged simply due to a change of mind, preference, or team roster changes after production. Please review all proofs with extreme care before approving.

5
Section 5

Production & Delivery Timelines

Production and delivery timelines are estimates provided in good faith based on current workload and shipping carrier schedules. We will communicate an estimated delivery timeline as part of your quote.

  • Production begins only after written proof approval and receipt of full payment.
  • Timeline estimates are not guaranteed and may be affected by factors outside our control, including shipping carrier delays, natural events, holidays, and material availability.
  • We are not liable for losses, costs, or damages resulting from production or shipping delays, including missed games, tournaments, or season deadlines.
  • Rush orders may be available at an additional cost. Contact us in advance to confirm availability.

If you have a hard deadline (e.g., first game date), please communicate this clearly at the time of your quote request. We will confirm whether we can meet the deadline before you commit to an order.

6
Section 6

Intellectual Property & Submitted Content

When you submit logos, artwork, images, or other content to us for use in your jersey design, you represent and warrant that:

  • You own or have the legal right to use all submitted content.
  • The submitted content does not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights, including copyrights, trademarks, or registered designs.
  • You have obtained all necessary permissions to use any logos, crests, or imagery associated with professional sports teams, licensed brands, or registered organizations.

Florida Basketball Jerseys will not knowingly reproduce content that infringes on the intellectual property rights of others. We reserve the right to decline production of any design we believe may infringe third-party rights.

Custom artwork created by us: Design proofs and artwork created by our design team in connection with your order remain the property of Florida Basketball Jerseys until full payment has been received. Upon full payment, artwork created specifically for your order may be used by you for the purposes of that order.

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Florida Basketball Jerseys from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from content you submitted that infringes on third-party intellectual property rights.

7
Section 7

Website Use & Prohibited Conduct

You agree to use our website and services only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe the rights of others. You may not:

  • Use our website for any fraudulent, illegal, or unauthorized purpose.
  • Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of our website, servers, or systems.
  • Transmit any harmful, offensive, or malicious code or content through our website.
  • Scrape, copy, or reproduce our website content, pricing, or design work without written permission.
  • Submit false or misleading information in any quote request or order form.
  • Resell or redistribute our products or services without prior written authorization.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to our website and services for any user who violates these terms.

8
Section 8

Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Florida Basketball Jerseys shall not be liable for:

  • Any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.
  • Loss of profits, revenue, data, or business opportunities.
  • Damages arising from your reliance on information on our website.
  • Delays in production or delivery beyond our reasonable control.
  • Errors in submitted customer content that was approved in a design proof.
  • Any issues arising from third-party shipping carriers after dispatch.

Our total liability to you for any claim arising from these terms or your order shall not exceed the amount you paid to us for the order giving rise to the claim.

No Warranty: Our website and services are provided "as is" without any warranty, express or implied. We do not warrant that our website will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of viruses or harmful components.

9
Section 9

Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

These Terms of Service and any disputes arising from them shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, United States of America, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

Any disputes between you and Florida Basketball Jerseys that cannot be resolved informally shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Orange County, Florida.

Before initiating any legal proceedings, you agree to attempt to resolve any dispute informally by contacting us at info@floridabasketballjerseys.com. We will attempt to resolve disputes within 30 days of receiving written notice.

10
Section 10

Privacy & Data

Your use of our website and services is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated into these Terms of Service by reference. By using our services, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in our Privacy Policy.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Information you provide through quote requests and order forms is used solely for fulfilling your order and communicating with you about our services.

Indemnification

You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Florida Basketball Jerseys and its officers, employees, agents, and partners from and against any claims, liabilities, damages, judgments, awards, losses, costs, expenses, or fees (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to:

Severability & Entire Agreement

If any provision of these Terms of Service is found to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect. The invalid provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.

These Terms of Service, together with our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Shipping Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and Florida Basketball Jerseys regarding your use of our website and services, and supersede all prior agreements and understandings, whether written or oral.

Changes to These Terms

We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review these terms periodically.

Your continued use of our website or services following the posting of any changes to these terms constitutes acceptance of those changes. If you do not agree with the updated terms, you should discontinue use of our website and services.
